news.title: 周杰伦与权志龙再度同框！不老男神 帅气依旧
news.summary: 近日，华语天王周杰伦与权志龙再度同框引发全网热议。在BIGBANG演唱会落幕之后，一张后台合照曝光，迅速引爆网络话题。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101023448640.png
近日，华语天王周杰伦与权志龙再度同框引发全网热议。在BIGBANG演唱会落幕之后，一张后台合照曝光，迅速引爆网络话题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101023553919.png
韩流天团BIGBANG于9日开启巡演，权志龙等成员登台带来精彩演出。周杰伦不仅提前送上花篮，并亲笔留言祝福“Have a great show！”，还亲自到场助阵观看演出。演出结束后，他在后台与BIGBANG三名成员合影留念，并在社交平台发文：“Nice to see you guys! Congratulations!”，让不少粉丝直呼梦幻联动。
事实上，两人私交早已备受关注。此前巴黎时装周二人就曾同框亮相；去年权志龙举办个人演唱会期间，周杰伦更是邀请其前往家中小聚、品酒畅谈艺术理念。两人交情深厚，也让无数歌迷持续期待未来能够迎来正式音乐跨界合作。

news.title: 《轮回之兽》重大更新上线！过场能跳过 能否拯救盘价
news.summary: 《轮回之兽》是一款由《宝可梦》系列开发商Game Freak出品的一款动作游戏，已于8月4日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5/Xbox平台。

content.v: 《轮回之兽》是一款由《宝可梦》系列开发商Game Freak出品的一款动作游戏，已于8月4日正式发售，登陆PC/PS5/Xbox平台。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101013172630.png
今日，《轮回之兽》官方宣布本作的V1.1.0版本更新现已发布，本次更新包含全新难度选项等内容。
以下为具体更新：
大家好！感谢各位一直游玩《轮回之兽》并积极反馈意见。本次是游戏发售之后的第 8 次更新，更新内容如下：
新增剧情推进选项
通关游戏中段的长城台地区域后，玩家可选择**直接跳过后续三个区域（朝圣者区域、松川聚居地、富士边境），或是正常游玩这部分地图。
该功能可以让只想专注主线剧情的玩家更快抵达都城，也方便新游戏 +（二周目及多周目）玩家快速推进流程。
新增设置选项
- 在选项菜单加入视野（FOV）调节功能
- 设置菜单新增过场 / 事件“跳过”提示的显示、隐藏开关
事件与过场动画优化
- 调整大量剧情过场的台词节奏与演出时序
- 修复跳过剧情后对话字幕残留在画面上的问题
- 修复快速跳过部分剧情，可能造成游戏软卡死、无响应的 BUG
- 修复跳过剧情之后，角色站位、镜头角度表现违和的问题
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101013382718.jpg
漏洞修复与技术优化
- 修复手动终止「纠缠爆发」时，会意外切换目标锁定开关状态的问题
- 修复释放库的绽放术时中断宝箱解锁流程，镜头会强制锁定到库身上的 BUG
- 修复库会对处于破韧状态敌人使用道具的问题
- 修复破韧标识一直残留在屏幕上的问题
- 修复守御魔像掉落的《手册：爆炸箭》无法在新游戏 + 模式获取的问题
- 拆分特效生成的运算负载，提升游戏整体性能
- 修复全地图多处场景缺陷：场景缝隙、模型穿模、不合理隐形墙等问题
- 调整全部区域的浸水判定深度与碰撞边界
最后和各位玩家说明：当前发售后持续更新周期即将结束。下一个补丁暂定 10 月 19 日上线（最终日期待定），这将是现阶段大型更新阶段的最后一个补丁。
此外，有玩家发现《轮回之兽》PS5实体版叠加PDD无门槛卷最低已经跌至58元左右。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101013265280.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610101013298494.png

策略玩法可以怎么搭出意想不到的套路？解谜关卡藏着什么样的巧思？平台跳跃又能不能挑战你的操作极限？这里有多款充满想法的学生原创游戏，等你一一体验！
游戏介绍
《玩个Gui2：天脊之下》
https://image.gcores.com/8106b6b9ac4061aae9ecb3ec107b9bb6-966-543.png
《玩个Gui2：天脊之下》是一款Roguelike类的策略游戏。在前作《玩个gui》“移动塔防”的创新玩法基础上，本作加入了更多富有挑战的关卡设计。您不仅需要精心规划错综复杂的轨道网络，部署并强化您独一无二的“战斗列车”，更要利用“炮塔附魔”等全新系统，为您的移动堡垒赋予毁灭性的能力。每一次布局都是智慧的博弈，每一次调整都关乎防线的存亡。
《神代之烬》
https://image.gcores.com/e570c6d7d9ee69400ec827448fc8edc7-966-543.png
《神代之烬》以古罗马神话为背景，玩家化身“烬火”重燃神代力量。核心为策略战棋玩法，通过符文石板操控主角行动以进行回合制战斗，强调资源管理与路径规划，带来策略博弈与编程行动的新颖体验。
《代号：大娘》
https://image.gcores.com/865e82e51ddfec94b5e9e94478a736a9-966-543.png
安史之乱撕裂了大唐。 你是一缕意识，附在一代剑舞大家公孙大娘的剑锋之上。她从江南到长安，追寻那个远去的帝王。 俯视战场，规划一条贯穿所有敌人的路线，她会沿着这条线弹射穿梭，一击斩杀所有挡路的人。 沿途遇见李白、杜甫、张旭、吴道子……故人重逢，也生死与共。 你替她看路，她替你出剑。史书合上了，她还在走。
《破损核心》
https://image.gcores.com/1d4a060706e041224efba0b096fecc1a-966-543.png
《破损核心》是一款肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。在未来的某一天，我们的垃圾回收机器人因意外导致能量核心被毁。你需要帮助它收集各种各样的垃圾，并利用能量回收机破坏这些垃圾，从中获取足够多的能量。帮助机器人修复它的能量核心。
《病毒》
https://image.gcores.com/e59b4ab2d813605870cac83614c82e4a-966-543.png
以真实的电脑桌面环境为背景，在混乱的病毒入侵场景下，用直观真实的操作逻辑抵御病毒的紧张操作体验。
《丰收牌局》
https://image.gcores.com/8bcf7c058788d9bdfc88b3f448e8ae9b-966-543.png
这是一款需要你亲手劳作的卡牌构筑种田游戏。在每季有限的回合与田地里，你要合理播种各类作物，巧妙运用各种机制，培育出高产的作物。从镰刀到收割机，收获的每个环节都由你亲手完成。构筑最强牌组，成为受人尊敬的农场主吧！
《挤猫猫》
https://image.gcores.com/297bed831217614852fe6db0fa747d92-966-543.png
推箱挪位，钻管探路，锁定爆破点，轰开迷宫暗墙！小猫 Coco 为无穷小鱼干勇闯猫神试炼，在手绘清新关卡里，邂逅温柔又烧脑的治愈谜题。小老鼠伙伴会一路吱吱提醒，伴你前行。
《引力子》
https://image.gcores.com/8aaa61dd4d91f973171ac81e2445e86a-966-480.png
掌控重力，破解这款 2D 平台解谜游戏的谜题！化身科学家，探索黑洞附近的废弃空间站，揭开它的过往，发掘未知物理法则下的世界运转之道。反重力、反物质、磁场等机制颠覆常规逻辑 —— 你的物理直觉就是通关关键。
《阿比亚：弹射之旅》
https://image.gcores.com/a24b830cb1641540ede9f47376da27d0-966-543.png
《阿比亚:弹射之旅》是一款平台动作游戏。您将扮演机器人阿比亚从末世废墟的地底醒来，一路跳跃、攀爬、射击，在危机四伏的地下世界里寻找真相。在风格迥异的区域中，您还会遇到不同势力的角色，在不断地深入探索中，终将发现这个世界的秘密。
《小小秦棋攻略》
https://image.gcores.com/f4d22f118c1231cd937697e29ae9aa33-966-543.png
这是一个结合了肉鸽要素的带有塔防体验的抽象棋类游戏，玩家必须依照直接或间接连接到主帅的方式，打出自己子库的棋子。当自己的棋子打入到对方的底线累计X分就获得胜利。
在游戏过程中玩家需要通过规划和连接自己不同的棋子来达成联合防御和破坏对方胜利的目的。
《从万事屋开始的冒险者公会》
https://image.gcores.com/da6f3bc2c380e8aa1f2e5cef355d005f-966-543.png
《从万事屋开始的冒险者公会》是一款日式西幻题材的模拟经营游戏。玩家将扮演失去记忆的精灵，从经营一间小小的万事屋开始，接待委托、结识形形色色的冒险者，在一次次判断与选择中解决小镇的问题，并逐渐将万事屋发展为真正的冒险者公会。
《Ghost out of the Shell》
“这是一个被圣剑选中的勇者的故事，但你并不是故事的主角。”
《Ghost out of the Shell》是一块俯视角潜行冒险游戏，在故事中，你不再是拯救世界的勇者，而是一个被勇者抛弃的本应操控他的幽灵。尽管失去了躯壳，但你也因此获得了附身故事中其他角色的能力，通过这一能力，你踏上了追寻勇者并尝试重新控制它的冒险。
《夜幕档案》
夜幕落下，档案室的门在你身后关上。门外的这条街上，有人撒谎，有人伪装，还有人胡言乱语。你的任务，就是从字里行间找出那个经不起推敲的瞬间。“排除所有不可能，剩下的无论多么不可思议，那都是真相。”
《平面设计 101》
你是一名毕业即失业的大学生，意外进入了一家平面设计公司。你将会遇到各种各样的设计要求和奇怪的甲方。根据甲方要求，运用各种设计工具和你高超的平面设计能力，在一次次尝试中摸索甲方的要求喜好。只要关键部分达成要求，剩余的画面就完全由你掌控。设计出完美的作品，完成挑战吧！
《刺球》
化身灵活又倔强的刺球，在险峻高塔间翻滚前进，伸缩双腿寻找支点、积蓄力量，一跃跨越机关与深渊。这里没有轻松的捷径，每次失误都可能让你跌回谷底；但只要稳住节奏、掌握惯性，下一次起跳，便可能抵达从未见过的高度！
当然，现场还有集章打卡、互动抽奖以及周边小礼品等你来解锁~
这个 10 月，欢迎来到Hit Academy【B12】展位，试玩游戏、参与互动，说不定就能发现你的“下一款上头游戏”！

news.title: 「吉考斯工业 × 影之刃零」联名展示空间视觉公开
news.summary: 大家好，欢迎光临吉考斯工业！ 距离核聚变嘉年华北京站举办还剩不到一个月的时间，我们的各项筹备工作正在紧锣密鼓地推进中。值得一提的是，此次吉考斯工业的展位将带来一次全新的尝试——为了庆祝「吉考斯工业 × 影之刃零」联名服饰

content.v: 大家好，欢迎光临吉考斯工业！
距离核聚变嘉年华北京站举办还剩不到一个月的时间，我们的各项筹备工作正在紧锣密鼓地推进中。值得一提的是，此次吉考斯工业的展位将带来一次全新的尝试——为了庆祝「吉考斯工业 × 影之刃零」联名服饰在现场的超前线下首发以及时隔不久的游戏正式发售，我们在展位的另一侧打造了特别展示空间。
在这里，你不仅可以抢先试穿全系列联名服饰，更能近距离欣赏极具沉浸感的游戏实物道具，感受这场暗黑武侠与潮流服饰的交织碰撞。
在空间视觉设计上，我们从游戏美学中汲取核心灵感，采用标志性的红黑色作为主色调，并辅以象征着命运纠葛、爱恨纵横的纤细红线作为点缀。
https://image.gcores.com/83ff72cd68083194680301cb6861790c-1921-1081.jpeg
https://image.gcores.com/250c94b83879cf2cfe27a95f3f57b56f-1921-1081.jpeg
特别值得一提的是，本次展示空间在陈列上迎来了三件重磅级的“宝贝”——游戏开发过程中实际使用的珍贵道具原型将集体亮相：
主角“魂”所使用的标志性兵刃
https://image.gcores.com/47de6db01cf8c2823870078291283a72-3840-2160.png
充满神秘诡谲美学的面具
https://image.gcores.com/585dc90142f48525af3a20bdddb39a68-3840-2160.webp
以及此前惊艳亮相的舞狮 BOSS「烈焰」的狮头实物
https://image.gcores.com/b18ba53be37015a0102ce898f2103b75-3840-2160.png
官方原版道具现身线下，在现场你可以直面感受这股扑面而来的压迫感与工艺细节，机会十分难得！积极参与现场打卡活动还能获得我们准备的纪念品。
不止于此，本次发售的联名服饰在此展示空间内均有展示，每一款都凝聚了我们对《影之刃零》世界观的解构，以及藏在面料与剪裁中的设计巧思，欢迎大家在现场试穿挑选。
最后提醒一下，核聚变嘉年华北京站将于 10 月 24、25 日在北京首钢国际会展中心 1 号馆举办，我们的展位在 A09 ，在现场我们将首发「吉考斯工业 × 影之刃零」联名系列，随后线上发售将于 10 月 29日 与游戏同步开启。
关于联名服饰的具体细节，请随时关注吉考斯工业官方发布的最新动态。

news.title: 54岁马化腾罕见公开露面 精神干练身材未发福
news.summary: 据财经网报道，近日，腾讯CEO马化腾陪同广东省领导前往腾讯深圳总部调研，并罕见公开露面。

content.v: 据财经网报道，近日，腾讯CEO马化腾陪同广东省领导前往腾讯深圳总部调研，并罕见公开露面。
调研期间，广东省领导现场观看了腾讯核心产品的应用演示，重点了解公司在人工智能领域的研发进展与创新成果。并听取企业近年来数字科创以及赋能多领域发展的情况介绍。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100956288443.png
马化腾全程陪同，期间与腾讯首席AI科学家姚顺雨相邻而坐。现年54岁的马化腾此次露面也引发网友关注。画面中的他头发乌黑、身形未见明显发福，整体状态显得精神干练。作为一向低调的互联网企业负责人，他的公开亮相受到不少关注。

news.summary: Including a look at frame gen toggle. Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen arrived on the Switch 2 this week, and if

content.v: Including a look at frame gen toggle.

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen arrived on the Switch 2 this week, and if you're curious to see how it compares to its PS5 counterpart, YouTube channel ElAnalistaDeBits has now released a side-by-side graphics comparison.

Firstly, players can apparently expect an upscaled resolution of 1080p in handheld and 1440p in docked mode. As for the game's performance, it hovers around 40fps, and if you toggle "on" frame generation, you'll experience the equivalent of 60fps.

news.title: 【抽奖】不只是挂机！自带91个职业的像素JRPG新游《幻想放置远征队》现已发售
news.summary: 由 One Interactive Studio 研发、Infini Fun 发行的 JRPG 风格挂机战斗养成游戏《幻想放置远征队》于 2026 年10月9日 在 Steam 平台正式发售。游戏定价36元，发售首两周内

content.v: 由 One Interactive Studio 研发、Infini Fun 发行的 JRPG 风格挂机战斗养成游戏《幻想放置远征队》于 2026 年10月9日 在 Steam 平台正式发售。游戏定价36元，发售首两周内购买可享八折优惠。
曾经那个为了拯救世界在屏幕前熬夜练级的你，现在是否已经被工作和学业填满？ 谁说忙碌的成年人就不配拥有一场波澜壮阔的 JRPG 冒险！ 两款 DLC 也随游戏本体同步上线。其中，“支持者包”包含营地四季皮肤，定价9元，首发期间同享八折特惠；“新手包”包含新角色“教官”及起步资源包，定价6元，首发首月内可免费领取。
https://image.gcores.com/5b5eb878b2f69a0729dbb37f62d52ad4-1265-713.jpeg
在这个名为“决斗者大陆”的像素世界里，你将从 91 种经典 JRPG 职业中招募心仪的成员，组建出专属的精锐旅团。游戏构建了清晰的双线养成循环：前线是昼夜不息的自动推图打怪，后方则是生机勃勃的营地建设——只需利用碎片时间打理酒馆、升级铁匠铺与商店，即可为前线队伍建立起坚不可摧的后方支援。
休闲放置，享受躺赢快感
作为一款放置在桌面底端的休闲挂机游戏，《幻想放置远征队》的操作非常简单：组建好队伍后，只需动动手指点开地图、选定出击目标，剩下的就放心交给这群像素小人。当你结束一天的工作或学习切回游戏时，迎接你的将是满仓的战利品：金币、装备、强化材料与追随者声望……享受最纯粹的数值成长与丰收快感！
https://image.gcores.com/f9e445ac85075bd77fc582bb97dff716-1070-601.png
海量职业，组建专属旅团
即使是放置挂机，本作依然保留了极高的策略自由度。游戏完整版包含 7 大主职业，并一路衍生出多达 91 个细分职业，每一个职业都配有专属的技能效果与手绘战斗动画。在阵容搭配上，这里没有“不按套路出牌就打不过”的数值绑架。可以遵循经典的“战法牧”稳扎稳打，也可以组建全法师阵容追求极致爆发，甚至拉起一支纯战士菜刀队硬刚到底。
https://image.gcores.com/7fc7351a11369c1cb5b802ff3e12d7fb-1074-600.png
深度构筑，玩转硬核数值

配合极其自由的职业系统，游戏还提供了深度的装备构筑体系。挂机推关途中可刷取超过200件装备，涵盖武器、防具、饰品等不同槽位。这其中包含了 60 多件能为特定职业带来显著增益的“专属传说装备”，玩家可以围绕核心角色打造专属套装。不仅如此，游戏还引入了附魔系统，在基础属性外提供了广阔的自定义空间。你可以根据队伍的具体短板或战术特色，对装备进行定向强化，告别枯燥的“被动等掉落”，让硬核数值党与收集控都能找到长线的养成乐趣。
https://image.gcores.com/f0921de21ba22e164029f286a3d0c353-1265-710.png
营地经营，掌控全局收益
在无尽的战斗之外，游戏还融入了一套后方营地经营玩法。你需要打理酒馆来招募各路英雄，升级铁匠铺以持续产出强力装备，并委托商人将多余战利品变现。前线带回的资源用于建设营地，而营地产出的收益又将直接反哺队伍战力，形成了一套完整的资源流转链路。这套“大后方”系统，让你在看小人自动砍怪之余，也能充分享受稳步发育、掌控全局的快感。
https://image.gcores.com/ad7ee5eeb45cf51c24082967119605a4-1070-605.png
首发限时福利活动：挂机即领！
为了感谢玩家们的支持，在游戏首发折扣期间，制作组准备了丰厚的挂机大礼包。其中，还包含两件大后期才能掉落的“搞怪装备”，希望能为大家的远征增添一份欢乐。

news.title: 《龙之信条2》登陆NS2 能插帧到60 超出预期
news.summary: 《龙之信条2：黑暗觉者》于10月9日正式登陆Switch 2

content.v: 《龙之信条2：黑暗觉者》于10月9日正式登陆Switch 2，一份与PS5版本的画质对比视频展示了卡普空这次移植的成果与取舍。
视频欣赏：
截图欣赏：
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100928422171.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100928437577.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100928445933.png
画质层面，Switch 2版在掌机模式下以1080p升频分辨率运行，底座模式则提升至1440p。PS5版则以4K升频分辨率运行，并支持Switch 2版缺失的光线追踪。纹理细节和绘制距离方面，Switch 2版均有明显缩减，对比中可察觉差异，但整体视觉呈现仍然“令人信服”。
性能表现是最大的妥协所在。Switch 2版目标帧率为30 FPS，实际运行中通常能保持在30帧以上，部分场景可达45 FPS左右，但在开放世界探索时帧率多在30至40 FPS之间波动，无法稳定维持60帧。PS5版则在性能模式下能够稳定维持60 FPS，即便在NPC密集的城市场景中也能保持稳定。
为弥补性能差距，Switch 2版首次在卡普空作品中引入AMD FSR帧生成技术。游戏本身以30帧渲染，通过FSR插帧实现“等效60帧”的流畅观感。制作人大山直人确认，插帧在部分场景中会产生轻微鬼影，但整体游戏体验不会受到显著影响。该功能可在最终版本中随时开启或关闭。
卡普空制作人此前曾表示，Switch 2版的表现“超出我们预期”，团队为PS5和Xbox版本所做的优化工作同样让Switch 2版受益。大山直人还指出，RE引擎“非常适合Switch 2”，这一良性循环将让未来作品持续受益。
整体而言，Switch 2版《龙之信条2：黑暗觉者》在硬件限制下实现了可玩的移植，画面与性能的妥协在预期范围之内，帧生成技术的引入则为追求流畅度的玩家提供了选择。游戏现已登陆PC、PS5、Xbox Series X|S及Nintendo Switch 2平台。

content.v: 据Fami通报道，《寂静岭》系列制作人冈本基在采访中透露，在第一波复兴项目大获成功之后，科乐美已经在规划系列的第二、第三波新作阵容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091523047246.jpg
2022年《寂静岭》线上发布会公布的三款作品现已全部完成发售，《寂静岭2：重制版》、《寂静岭f》、《寂静岭：小镇陷落》均收获不错口碑。冈本基表示，首批项目顺利落地让团队松了一口气，但这并不是系列复兴的终点。他坦言目前已经在评估多个新项目，只是暂无法对外披露具体情报。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091523101417.jpg
冈本基回忆，当初说服高层同时推进多款《寂静岭》作品并不容易。鉴于此前《P.T.》项目取消留下的心理阴影，如果仅仅只推出一款作品，粉丝难免会担心项目再度中途夭折。科乐美最终敲定多线并行策略，甚至追加了PS5独占免费游戏《寂静岭：短信》，以此重建玩家对IP的信心。

news.title: 去医院看病前先用豆包查症状 医生无奈了
news.summary: 近日，一张写着“已在豆包拿到诊断的患者请改问千问”的门诊告示在社交平台走红，不过，这张图片实际上是网友制作的恶搞段子，并非…

content.v: 近日，一张写着“已在豆包拿到诊断的患者请改问千问”的门诊告示在社交平台走红，不过，这张图片实际上是网友制作的恶搞段子，并非正规医疗机构发布的真实公告。话虽是玩笑，却引发了不少讨论，毕竟，如今越来越多的人习惯在看病前使用AI分析症状、解读检查报告。
编辑观点： 只要能合理地利用AI获取信息，并且不被它给出的答案先入为主地影响判断，那么AI当然可以成为看病前的辅助工具，但短期内显然还不能代替医生做诊断。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091543341184.png
对于绝大多数普通人来说，面对陌生的医学名词、复杂的检查报告，或者一些难以准确描述的身体不适，AI可以用相对通俗的语言进行解释，帮助用户整理症状、了解相关知识，确实能够降低获取健康信息的门槛。如果患者能提前先梳理自己出现了哪些症状、持续了多长时间，再带着具体问题向医生咨询，也能减轻医生的工作压力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091543433809.png
并且，有些我们平常可能不以为然的小毛病，或许就是重大疾病发作之前的预警，在AI的帮助下，患者或许就能提前意识到事态的紧急，避免酿成悲剧。
当然，任何AI给出的内容都应当谨慎对待，“百度看病，癌症起步”的传闻犹在耳边，在未经专业人士问诊之前，仅凭患者的主观感受所输入的文字，有可能引出完全不同的病例，从而造成不必要的焦虑甚至是错误的处理方式。
更现实的情况是，患者可能会拿着AI给出的结论先入为主，出现不该出现的心理作用，导致医生无法通过正常、规范、科学的流程去确定真正的病因，既有误导医生的可能，也有因不同意见而令患者困惑的可能。一来二去反而本末倒置。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091543553956.jpeg
那么问题来了，你看病时会不会先用豆包、千问等AI工具查询症状或解读检查报告？如果AI的判断与医生不同，你会把它当作进一步咨询的线索，还是会怀疑医生的诊断？欢迎在评论区聊聊你的经历和看法。

content.v: 《漫威金刚狼》是一款由索尼旗下第一方工作室“失眠组”Insomniac Games打造的动作冒险游戏，已于9月15日正式发售，独占登陆PS5平台。

这份统计覆盖大约两周的发售周期，单看数字并不算亮眼。受作品本身属性、口碑反响一般的影响，游戏销量主要集中在首发期。另一家机构Alinea Analytics 在 9 月 17 日给出的全球预估则为190万份。需要注意，两家机构均为第三方估算，Ampere 统计 45 个重点市场、Alinea 聚合全球数据，都并非索尼官方数据。

news.title: 百小时大作太累了 前PS总裁呼吁回归20小时精品
news.summary: 如今，电子游戏的规模越来越庞大，无论开发还是购买，成本都在不断攀升。

content.v: 如今，电子游戏的规模越来越庞大，无论开发还是购买，成本都在不断攀升。有人认为，现在的游戏普遍做得有些过于庞大，日益膨胀的开发预算也不利于整个行业的发展。索尼互动娱乐全球工作室前负责人肖恩·莱登（Shawn Layden）对此表示认同，并认为，如果发行商能够将更多精力放在规模较小的游戏上，将有利于整个行业。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100911352161.png
莱登在参加播客节目Expansion Pass时谈到了自己的看法。“我参与过很多游戏项目，它们的游玩时长达到80小时、90小时，甚至100小时。”莱登说道，“我可以第一个承认，这些时间并不全都属于优质体验。有时候，你只是在沙漠里跑来跑去，寻找一把红色钥匙，再拿着它回来打开那扇红色的门。”
在他看来，游戏开发应该重新回归规模适中、内容紧凑且具有吸引力的作品。“所以，我更希望看到这样的游戏：拥有20至25小时的优质内容，就像电影一样，全程充满精彩场面，让你根本舍不得放下手柄。”莱登补充道。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100911428610.png
看看如今有多少游戏，尤其是3A级大作，采用了开放世界或沙盒式设计，就能理解他的意思。《刺客信条》系列、《最终幻想》系列，以及《光与影：33号远征队》等作品，都需要玩家投入大量时间和精力才能通关，其中也难免存在一些繁琐、重复的内容。
莱登认为，这种追求游戏时长的设计思路，部分源于上世纪90年代的游戏租赁文化。当时，开发者会想方设法延长游戏流程，避免玩家租来游戏后，仅用一个周末就能通关。随着时间推移，这种做法逐渐演变成游戏设计中的一种惯性。
“我希望游戏能够保持紧凑，始终精彩不断，这才是我希望看到的发展方向。”莱登表示，“如果我们能够制作规模更小的游戏，并从一开始就以这种模式为目标，我认为游戏开发的相关成本就有望开始下降，至少也应该停止持续上涨。”

news.title: 7000名玩家票选出最垃圾视觉效果：动态模糊
news.summary: PC Gamer近日举办了一场游戏图形效果淘汰赛

content.v: PC Gamer近日举办了一场游戏图形效果淘汰赛，让玩家投票选出最令人讨厌的画面效果。经过多轮对决，动态模糊在决赛中以80%对20% 的压倒性优势击败色差，被正式“确认”为游戏中最糟糕的图形效果。整个赛事共吸引约7000人参与投票。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100900182414.png
在决赛中，PC Gamer收到了近2000份投票。动态模糊拿下80%的选票，色差仅获得20%。编辑Jacob Ridley在文章中写道：“我们终于可以以近乎科学的确定性宣布，动态模糊是最烂的。而且是以绝对压倒性的优势。”他还坦言，这个结果从一开始就毫无悬念，“我知道，你也知道，我们内心深处都知道”。
尽管被票选为最差，PC Gamer还是给了动态模糊一些“公道话”。文章承认，在低帧率场景——尤其是主机平台上——以及赛车游戏等特定类型中，适度使用动态模糊确实有其价值。它本质上是一种掩盖画面瑕疵的手段。而且对PC玩家来说，动态模糊通常是可选的，可以在设置菜单中关闭。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100901169261.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100901171393.png
问题在于，动态模糊往往默认开启，且不会在性能达标时自动关闭。PC Gamer编辑描述了自己的习惯：“每次启动游戏，第一件事就是进设置菜单关掉动态模糊。这已经成了肌肉记忆，像刷牙一样根深蒂固。”文章最后写道，只要开发者继续默认开启动态模糊，玩家就会继续关掉它，“如此循环往复，直到我们全部消亡”。

It's called Johnny Mnemonic, and folks, it is cinema .

Johnny Mnemonic, based on a William Gibson short story of the same name, came out in 1995 and is set in the year 2021, which as you may know has already come and gone. Reeves plays a "mnemonic courier" who transports sensitive information in his head—he can carry nearly 80 gigs of data!—because the internet is an insecure digital goat rodeo filled with scammers, grifters, hackers, and various other forms of criminal lowlife. (The movie sure got that right, at least.)

Johnny (Mnemonic, not Silverhand) takes on a high-risk, high-reward mission, which naturally goes south almost immediately: He's hunted by the yakuza, betrayed by his handler, rescued by a sexy cyborg, gets his ass beat by a preacher, is saved by a dolphin, and ultimately destroys capitalism. Something like that, anyway—it's been a while.
This is what the internet should have been
I did in fact pay money to see Johnny Mnemonic in the theater: I'm not sure why, really, except that Reeves was still flying high after Speed, and the Johnny Mnemonic cast was absolutely stacked :

"I want room service!"

news.title: 万智牌回归漫威，推出《黑暗堡垒命运》
news.summary: Magic the Gathering and Marvel have already crossed over a couple of times with Spider-Man and the Marvel Supe

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/08/mdd-1-1791498129253.jpg

Magic: The Gathering and Marvel have already crossed over a couple of times with Spider-Man and the Marvel Super Heroes set last year. But for its third Marvel set, MTG is getting spooky with Darkhold Destiny.

Rather than being based in a fairly mundane version of New York, Darkhold Destiny is taking the likes of Doctor Strange and the Asgardians and telling a more magical story (forgive me). What really separates this new out-there set from the other two Marvel sets is that Wizards of the Coast was really able to write its own story with Marvel's characters and settings, which makes them feel less like a crossover and more like a part of Magic's multiverse.

With a new story written in-house, Wizards of the Coast was also able to give its artists more license to create their own takes on Marvel characters. For instance, with Scarlet Witch in the Marvel Super Heroes set, she looks like a pretty standard take on her comic book appearance. But in the art I was shown for Darkhold Destiny, she looks much more like an MTG character, while still retaining some of the signature parts of her outfit – the mask is still there.

I was also given broad strokes of what the story is about. Essentially, Dormammu and Hela use the Darkhold to invade the entire multiverse, and it's up to Doctor Strange, Thor, and other Marvel heroes to stop them. Of course, because of the characters and, well, props that the story revolves around, the set is focused heavily on spellcasting.

Thematically, the spellcasting is focused on what's essentially three different 'schools' of magic: Arcane, Divine, and Dark. Arcane magic will be themed around Doctor Strange and his allies, while Divine magic will be wielded by the Asgardians and other similar... entities. Dark magic is primarily going to be wielded by the villains of the set, but there are some heroes, like Ghost Rider that will apparently be wielding Dark magic.

You can expect a lot of focus on cool instants, sorceries and 'unique enchantments.' Wizards is even bringing back the Arcane subtype on instants and sorceries, which hasn't been used since Saviors of Kamigawa all the way back in 2005. I even asked if WotC is bringing back the obscure 'Splice Onto Arcane' ability that let you combine different arcane spells, but sadly, it is not.

Just like any other recent set, there will be a whole lineup of different Darkhold Destiny products. The standard fare is all here, Booster Packs, Collector Boosters and Bundles; but there will also be four commander decks.

Each of these commander decks will also have a collector's edition available, which will be completely decked out in foils. There will also be two scene boxes, each with six mechanically unique cards. Both the Bundle and the special Gift Bundle will also come with a mechanically unique promo card, and I just hope they don't skyrocket immediately on TCGPlayer, but I know that they probably will.

Wizards of the Coast will be giving the first glimpse of its original Marvel story in February with a comic produced alongside Image comics. Then, another comic will come out closer to when the set launches in April 2027.

news.title: 《战争机器》新作拉了？曝首周仅卖出23万份
news.summary: 《战争机器：事变日》在发售首周仅售出约23万份

content.v: 据Alinea Analytics分析师Rhys Elliott公布的数据，《战争机器：事变日》在发售首周仅售出约23万份，其中Steam平台占16.8万份，Xbox生态（含主机和PC）仅售出6.2万份。对于一款承载Xbox独占战略重任的旗舰级作品而言，这一数字被Elliott形容为“疲软”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100835176210.png

与低迷的直接销量形成对比的是，Alinea Analytics估算约有170万玩家通过Game Pass订阅游玩了《战争机器：事变日》。其中，72.2万订阅用户额外支付了30美元购买高级版升级，以获取提前五天体验资格。Elliott指出，Game Pass正在“蚕食大部分高级版收入”——在Xbox平台上，每售出一份游戏，就对应近12份Game Pass高级版升级，“70美元版本在Xbox上已经功能性死亡”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100835268567.png

尽管Steam贡献了大部分销量，但Xbox生态贡献了更高的收入。据Elliott估算，游戏总收入约3700万美元，其中Xbox生态贡献约2600万至2700万美元，Steam约1100万美元。将72.2万份升级计算在内，实际上有近95万人为《E-Day》支付了费用。Elliott推测，如果没有首发日Game Pass，许多玩家本会以70美元全价购买，“他们花30美元买了五天提前体验一个并不属于他们的东西”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/10/small_202610100835353266.png
微软尚未对上述数据作出官方回应。Elliott同时指出，这些数字仅反映付费情况，Game Pass新增订阅数等更完整的商业影响仍有待观察。随着Xbox CEO阿莎·夏尔马已明确《使命召唤》新作不再首发入库Game Pass，《战争机器》等旗舰系列未来是否会跟进调整发行策略，将成为关注焦点。

content.v: Today at New York Comic Con, Wizards of the Coast announced the first 2027 Universes Beyond expansion set for Magic: The Gathering. Marvel’s Darkhold Destiny will pit Doctor Strange, Thor, Ghost Rider, and more against cosmic villains like Hela and Dormammu in 2027.

Darkhold Destiny tells an original story co-created by designers at Marvel and Wizards of the Coast. Along with that story, a brand-new character created for this set will be introduced in a Marvel Infinity comic series starting in February.

news.title: 2026 年的 OLED 显示器几乎可以重现 90 年代 CRT 的卓越清晰度，但 Windows 必须做出改变才能实现真正的涅槃
news.summary: All you need is a ridiculously fast monitor and endless patience for tinkering to get a glimpse of how good re

content.v: The 2007 season finale of TV phenom Lost ended with an all-timer twist: What had seemed like the show's routine flashback storyline, filling in the events that preceded its characters ending up in island purgatory, was actually a flash forward . Protagonists Jack and Kate were somehow safe in Los Angeles after three seasons of being stuck on the mysterious island. Escaping had been the whole point of the show—or so we thought, until a broken Jack cried "We have to go back!"

This is now how I feel about, frankly, a lot of technology. Not long before that episode aired I'd gleefully dropped $1,000 on my first HD display, a 26-inch 1366x768 Samsung LCD that served as my college dorm TV and doubled as my computer monitor. For the time it was state of the art, so much thinner and sharper and better than the CRT monitor still attached to the family PC.
Or was it?
Twenty years later, experts who are tuned into the minutia of display tech are still trying to get back what we lost.

"People older than 40 will generally remember the motion clarity of CRTs, while younger people who've never seen a CRT will not remember," says Mark Rejhon, founder of the website Blur Busters . For years, Blur Busters' "Test UFO" browser tool, starring a little green man in a red saucer, has served as the de facto way to judge the clarity of objects in motion on modern displays. Compared to older CRT monitors, the LCDs of the mid-2000s were particularly terrible, their pixels taking an eternity to change from one color to another and leaving a nasty "ghost" trail on fast-moving images.

The TV I spent an entire month's paycheck on was better than average for its day, but the novelty of the HD era made me overlook then what's far more obvious now: the richer colors and smoothness of a CRT that I gave up, and wouldn't get back for nearly two decades.
Today's high refresh monitors are far better than the smeary, washed out LCDs of the 2000s—but even the best of the best are still chasing the clarity of CRTs, which means Rejhon is chasing it too.
Cathode ray 'tude
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wGo7WgJT9dzVCnVYatg6Yb-1920-80.jpg

While ShaderBeam tries to eradicate motion blur in software, Nvidia's tackling it in hardware. G-Sync Pulsar (built into a range of gaming monitors this year) works with VRR and uses backlight strobing plus a rolling top-to-bottom refresh cycle, much like a CRT, to create a "perceived clarity" of 1,000 Hz. No OLEDs yet, though, and the tech is of course locked to Nvidia GPUs.

In late 2024 Rejhon debuted a "breakthrough algorithm for simulating a CRT tube " alongside former Nvidia developer Timothy Lottes, which takes advantage of 240+ Hz displays to drastically reduce visible motion blur in retro games and other content that's locked at 60 Hz.

The trick, to grossly simplify some extremely complicated tech, is recreating the visual "phosphor fade" of a CRT, which is gentler on the eyes and less flickery than harsh black frame insertion (BFI), the previous go-to method for cutting down on blur as pixels swap from one color to another.

"The two main ways to reduce display motion blur is either flicker the frames (like a CRT) or add more frame rate (for high Hz)," Rejhon said. "Both methods will show frames more briefly, like a fast camera shutter, and result in less display motion blur. CRTs could flicker pixels brightly for less than 1/1000 second. The bonus with CRT is you do not require more frame rate to achieve low motion blur."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/fvQq7o4nWyRfhpJb3vYGkK-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pPJnJ96GDT3bQfyN2FpGuK-1920-80.jpg

If that's still tough to wrap your brain around, think of the CRT simulation as DLSS, but for motion instead of resolution: When it's working just right, a game locked at 60 frames per second could look just as smooth and clean as one running at, say, 540 frames per second, without needing an RTX 5090 to hit those numbers.

540 Hz is the refresh rate of the ROG PG27AQWP-W Asus sent me for testing, an ideal monitor for getting the most out of CRT simulation. It even has a 720 Hz mode if you drop the resolution to 720p; and the higher the refresh, the more you can reduce the perceived motion blur. Unlike LCDs, OLED panels can go completely black (there's no backlight to bleed light) and get extremely bright, getting much closer to the contrast CRTs naturally offered. And the high refresh rate helps recreate the electron beam that would travel down a CRT screen to "draw" the image.

This effect isn't just a nostalgia thing: As Rejhon notes on BlurBusters, "60 Hz BFI and strobing flickers a lot" because you're flashing a black frame in between each one from your game. By comparison, the top-to-bottom scanning effect is less harsh: "CRT simulation is much gentler for 60 fps content, because of phosphor fade & rolling scan. Some light is emitted somewhere else on the screen all the time."
Despite the perfect hardware to test on, though, CRT simulation is so bleeding edge I practically sliced my brain to ribbons trying to get it working earlier this year.

The first actual implementation of BlurBusters' tech was in a shader for the emulation frontend Retroarch, but soon after it was built into an experimental branch of a standalone app called ShaderGlass , a great overlay for Windows that lets you apply hundreds of visual effects to whatever's on your desktop—scanlines, the fuzziness of an analog video signal, and so on. But the CRT beam simulation is so much more complex than a typical video shader, app developer Mausimus decided to split it off into a separate tool: ShaderBeam .

"The ideal application of beam simulation technology requires perfect synchronization with both the display (it cannot afford to drop a single frame even at those high refresh rates, since that causes very noticeable flashing) and input content (for aligning source frame generation with simulated CRT refresh rate)," said Mausimus. Right now, it's the best way to use Rejhon's algorithm.
Shader dreams

ShaderBeam doesn't involve much setup: launch its executable and use a hotkey to apply the shader on top of a game window. How simple it looks belies how hard the visual effect is to pull off when you don't work at Microsoft, AMD or Nvidia.

"ShaderBeam tries to use whatever's available, like screen capture and window transparency (even though these technologies weren't designed with this use case in mind at all and provide no timing guarantees whatsoever), to compensate for the inability to insert itself into the rendering pipeline from source content to display," Mausimus said. "It's at the mercy of opaque scheduling algorithms built into the OS and GPU drivers, hoping it can eke out enough resources to maintain its timing."

The ideal ShaderBeam setup involves disabling usual niceties like VRR, turning off all sorts of features in your graphic's cards driver settings, unplugging secondary monitors, using Process Lasso to give it higher priority, and even a registry edit. It includes the novel idea of splitting up the responsibilities of rendering the game and the CRT shader to two GPUs. If your processor has a built-in GPU, using it can help avoid a desync between the rate at which your game is spitting out frames and the rate at which ShaderBeam can apply the CRT beam simulation.

news.title: GTA 6 粉丝称 Rockstar 只因为他们提出了好意而给他们寄了一张海报
news.summary: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – an

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/gta-6-cover-art-1791589629353.jpg
A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through.

Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month. What began as a "shot-in-the-dark email" they sent to Rockstar asking for a signed GTA 6 poster has turned into what seems to be a heartwarming moment for them and the community.
"A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room.

"Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil."

You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues.

"This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter . "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this."

"​I blurred out all personal addresses, names, and contact emails to respect their privacy," aogustoo added. "Please don't flood their inbox with requests, as I'm pretty sure this was just a rare act of kindness from someone on their team."

There's still so much about GTA 6 that we don’t know, but one thing is for sure: Rockstar will probably get even more emails after this. While we wait to learn more about the next Grand Theft Auto game ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, you can check out IGN's recent interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson . You can also read about what Nintendo had to say about the chances of seeing GTA 6 on Switch 2 , some recently revealed radio stations , and even a batch of new screenshots .

news.title: “煮过头让你支离破碎，而怯场则能让你重新团结起来”
news.summary: Developers of the stressful cooking game series talk to PC Gamer about their more 'positive' co-op adventure.

content.v: I introduced Overcooked to two of my friends one day back in 2016. One day being the key phrase here. The Overcooked games are on our list of the best co-op games , but the series has a reputation for ruining relationships—in China it's apparently known as "The Divorce Kitchen". I don't recall actually fighting with my friends, but the tension was thick enough that we quickly went back to playing Jackbox instead.

That makes Stage Fright, which is being published by No Man's Sky developer Hello Games, kind of an interesting pivot for Ghost Town Games. It's the next co-op adventure from the makers of Overcooked, but it's aimed at building relationships with your play partner instead of leaving you irked at them.
Here's what Stage Fright's developers have to say about the tonal shift a decade later.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/svh5EoDJR5f98JEMCjzwHM-1920-80.jpg
"Overcooked broke you apart and Stage Fright is there to put you back together," said co-director Oliver De-Vine, when we spoke over Zoom in September.

"I think there's a sense of us trying to be constructive with co-op, and trying to be a constructive and positive force in the world," De-Vine said. "Not that there's anything negative, necessarily, about having a fun argument with your friends! But we're trying to foster community in our games. [They're] about communication between people, and less about being very good with the fidelity of a controller."

"It's exciting to us, the idea that the people who are good at our games are the ones who are good at communicating," said games designer Phil Duncan. "Certainly with Overcooked, one of the things we found with [demoing it at] conventions is that you would find a bunch of teenage boys would come and play it, and play in complete silence, and they'd fail the level horribly.

"And then you'd get two people, we had a little girl come up, and she was like eight years old, playing with her friend, and they're chatting the whole time. And they smashed through it, and they played absolutely effortlessly."
Couch co-op, even without a couch
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JvGUUPUDJQhG9vKR7TsiLM-1920-80.jpg
To make the co-op vibe of Stage Fright even more chummy, Ghost Town Games wants its players to feel like they're sitting on the couch with their friend—even when they're playing over the internet.

"I think it's a unique experience, local co-op particularly, versus playing games online," De-Vine said. "Even though our game is both local and online, we are trying to make the experience of online as similar to the local experience as possible. So the game is splitscreen online as well, because it does depend on being able to see what the other player is doing and communicate about what they're seeing in the environment."
"The ideal situation is that you're sat next to someone and you're nudging them and you point at the same thing. So it's as close as we can get to that online," Duncan said.

In Stage Fright, two players will guide a pair of kids through a Luigi's Mansion-style adventure where they'll have to tackle puzzles, avoid threats, and solve a mystery, with nothing to rely on but their partners. While there's more complexity in the adventure than in their chaotic kitchens, the devs didn't want to lose the accessibility of Overcooked's single-button action.
"Imagine family-friendly Silent Hill"
"When we talk about puzzle aspects or escape room aspects, we're trying to avoid having a game where you have to get a notepad out and write things down," De-Vine said.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/qsNHEYqUMie4mMTurT5PHM-1920-80.jpg

"Everything is communicated between the players verbally. It's got adventure game elements, but without an inventory. There's no inventory management. Everything is physical items you're carrying around in a similar way to Overcooked, sort of quite large, obvious, chunky items, and that is again trying to make sure that everything is out loud in communication."
I asked if it was a linear type of game, where players need to solve puzzles in order, or if they'll be able to try a different puzzle and come back later when they get stuck.

"Similar to how you would find an escape room experience, where you'll find a clue, and it won't necessarily be linked to the thing [you're solving], you'll have to remember that for later," De-Vine said.
"It's linear in the way that Silent Hill is linear. Which is a weird comparison because it's not much like it," he said, laughing. "But you know, imagine family-friendly Silent Hill."

news.title: 让我们都高兴吧，这款 AAA 扫雷游戏不是真实的
news.summary: Minesweeper has been around for decades and it's probably overdue for some modern flourishes. Now there's a Tr

content.v: Minesweeper has been around for decades and it's probably overdue for some modern flourishes. Now there's a Triple-A Minesweeper parody that offers a hilarious look at what a Minesweeper update might look like.

The Triple-A Minesweeper was created by writer and programmer Mike Lacher, and it's fully playable as a browser game on his site . Aside from the intentionally pretentious title cards touting the involvement of Unreal Engine, Nvidia, Bink Video, and Wwise, Triple A Minesweeper looks and plays almost exactly like the regular Minesweeper.

However, the best way to enjoy this parody is by simply not doing anything at all. The main character, "Sweeper," will sit around and repeat things like, "I gotta sweep these mines," while receiving calls from newly created characters in the game. Lacher seems to have taken his inspiration from Grand Theft Auto 5, Metal Gear Solid, and even Cyberpunk 2077.

Among the callers are Nora, a potential love interest for Sweeper. Additionally, an underworld figure called The Don repeatedly calls for Sweeper to head down to his club while hinting at the latter's sinister past in Singapore. Meanwhile, the chipper DJ Dan celebrates Sweeper's efforts on behalf of New Dawn City.

In another amusing touch, Sweeper never acknowledges any of the other characters and keeps repeating the same lines over and over. It is possible to complete the game, which triggers a twist ending that probably wasn't that difficult to predict.
Although Lacher leaves the parody on that note, it would have been even funnier if the game's coda mentioned that Triple-A Minesweeper flopped and cost Microsoft hundreds of millions of dollars.

Microsoft hasn't done too much with Minesweeper in the past few years, although it was added to Microsoft Teams as a playable game. The company has also previously created a Minesweeper-themed ugly Christmas sweater .

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/10/marvel-mtg-blogroll-1791592739050.jpg

Wizards of the Coast just announced Magic: The Gathering Darkhold Destiny , its latest Marvel set in a New York Comic Con panel. This is the third Marvel collaboration for the card game, but where the first two were about presenting super heroes as they already exist in Marvel canon, Wizards of the Coast was able to cook up its own storyline for Darkhold Destiny.

The set revolves around the likes of Doctor Strange, Thor and Ghost Rider, all trying to work against Hela and Dormammu invading the multiverse. It's a much better thematic fit for Magic: The Gathering, and the early cards have introduced new mechanics like Vengeance, which is like the Adventure mechanic introduced in Throne of Eldraine, but evil .

Even though there was a lot of information in this panel, the set doesn't come out until April 8th next year, so there are still plenty of details that WotC is holding close to its chest. And, keep in mind that there are still two more Universes Beyond sets coming next year that we don't know anything about.
Magic The Gathing x Marvel @ NYCC Live Blog

news.title: 卢卡斯影业游戏制片人在《银河赛车手》角色比迪·布拉斯走红后做出回应
news.summary: If you’ve been on gaming Twitter recently, you’ve probably seen a clip from Star Wars: Galactic Racer making t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/biddy-blas-scrib-doon-1791575939855.jpg

If you’ve been on gaming Twitter recently, you’ve probably seen a clip from Star Wars: Galactic Racer making the rounds on your timeline — specifically, a player’s interaction with a character named Biddy Blas.

It’s almost impossible to hate the guy, who tells you all about how awesome he is in a hilarious spiel that has somehow become everyone’s new vocal stim. In Huttese, Blas tells you: “Here’s a name for you, amateur! Biddy Blas. Write it down. Tattoo it on your arm, and someday your arm will be worth millions!”

However, it’s the fantastic voice acting behind this line that’s got players cracking up. “Biddy Blas! Scrib doon!” is an undeniable banger, and I personally cannot stop saying it in response to basically anything. (My poor friend group is already tired of it.)
This Star Wars: Galactic Racer voice acting though! 💀🤣 https://t.co/oYkTMT2nSf

Posts of Blas introducing himself have gone viral on social media, to the point where they caught the attention of LucasFilm Games Producer Craig Derrick, who responded to the overwhelming influx of love for Blas on Twitter/X.

“It’s amazing to see so many people loving Galactic Racer!” he wrote. “Thank you for all the kind words! Every one of my social feeds is filled with posts about the game… while the algorithm continues to properly prioritize Mister Biddy Blas. I love it.”

Biddy Blas is a Crocin who, as players have come to find out, will literally do whatever it takes to win… even if that means giving you a ‘gift’ that’s actually a bomb, which, if you accept it, will explode your ship and give your opponents a major head start.

It’s amazing to see so many people loving Galactic Racer! Thank you for all the kind words! 🙏 Every one of my social feeds is filled with posts about the game… while the algorithm continues to properly prioritize Mister Biddy Blas. I love it. 😂 https://t.co/SdXjIq9HkF
Hate him or love him, the guy’s the talk of the town right now, with some fans affectionately dubbing him the “glup shitto of the year.”
“I would like to say I'd die for Biddy Blas, but at the same time, I have also slammed him into a wall at like 500mph multiple times at this stage,” one fan joked .
“Biddy Blas is hilarious, I'm going to kill him,” another said after their speeder got blown up thanks to accepting Blas’s ‘gift.’

Star Wars: Galactic Racer has been a major hit with Star Wars fans and critics alike, with IGN’s Luke Reilly scoring the game an eight out of ten. “Star Wars: Galactic Racer is a fabulous looking and frantically fast anti-grav racer that gets a little repetitive thanks to its heavy reliance on repeatedly revisiting the same slim selection of planets, but has successfully lit the afterburners on a long-dormant slice of the Star Wars universe,” he wrote in our review .

It’s a good time to be a pod racer, as developer Fuse Games recently announced that Galactic Racer’s multiplayer party limit will soon double in size in a post-launch patch coming in the next few weeks.

news.title: 别担心，Valve：我已经为你整理好了下一个死锁角色的概念
news.summary: The Cursed Apple is ready for Humpty Dumpty and the Loch Ness Monster's Precocious Preteen Child.

content.v: Deadlock is one of the most delightful things happening in videogame art direction. It's a festival of phenomenal vibes: a striking setting, an all-timer aesthetic that bleeds into every scrap of environmental art and UI element, and—crucially—a roster of instantly charming occult character designs.

That roster, however, is missing something—a few somethings, in fact. While Deadlock's heroes cover a broad spectrum of the spooky and supernatural, it's got some glaring gaps where foundational elements of cryptozoology and occult lore are sorely overlooked. But don't fret, Valve designers: I've done your next round of ideation for you. I've prepared some promising character concepts that, I think we'll all agree, will realize the Cursed Apple's untapped potential. Let's begin:
The Summer Mummy (from Heathcliff)
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/33SZW6AhUiX636MeDHFmm4-1920-80.jpg

Deadlock's already got draculas. It's got werewolves. It's got a Frankenstein. When you're already this deep in monster mash territory, a mummy's a layup. It's Spooky Stuff 101. The problem, however, is that it's not enough to be just a mummy in New York. New York is where they make cool people. If you're going to hang with the Cursed Apple's finest, you're going to need style.

Enter the Summer Mummy, a character first introduced in Heathcliff—the comic strip about the orange cat who isn't Garfield—on August 17, 2023 . The Summer Mummy is much like your typical bandaged revenant, except chill and fun. He wears floral boardshorts. He has sunglasses. He eats ice cream ( the Summer Mummy gets the sand flavor ). He's an instant crowd pleaser, and it's an incredible cross-promotional opportunity. Everyone's trying to tap the lucrative Heathcliff brand.
A minotaur who plays baseball professionally
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/LXo7fuxHE8avFatFJJ4mBf-1920-80.jpg

Just to be clear: No, I didn't come up with this one because "bullpen" is a baseball thing. I just thought a minotaur in an old-timey baseball uniform would look sick. I only realized the bullpen bit afterwards—but as far as I'm concerned, that was me getting a thumbs up from an angel for my very good work.

What was the labyrinth if not the most mythological bullpen of them all? The minotaur might've been warming up his pitching arm down there. Gotta pass the time somehow. Oh! He could throw a curveball that follows a nonsense, labyrinthine path through the air. Call it a Daedalian Knuckleball or something. Give him a bull rush ability called "charge the mound." Stuff writes itself. Put my check in the mail.
The Loch Ness Monster's precocious preteen child
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hN5dEvSdtULk3TT3JWePz8-1920-80.jpg

There's a lot to love about this one: First, Nessie is already confirmed Deadlock canon , having arrived on Earth through the Bermuda Triangle astral gate. Second, there's never a bad time for more Scottish accents. Third, they could be buddies with Rem, Deadlock's adorable sleepspace creature.

But what really makes Nessie Jr. (legally, that name might be taken ) a winner is the microtransaction potential: Give this kid a character lunchbox, and once Deadlock starts rolling out purchasable skins, people will pay whatever you ask just to see different fictional licensed properties slapped on there. It's infinite money.
Three gnomes in a trench coat
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/u7sqLkGHAVsDan2xjHDVhe-1920-80.jpg

I'll confess: I don't have a lot to flesh this entry out with. Mostly, I just think it would be neat for all of them to have little guns under there. Maybe they're in the mob? A gnome mafia. The Cosa Gnomestra. I don't know. Do your best.
A haunted suit of armor (who is a boxer)
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/gGikJ74oYzrCEk3nVbEmpZ-1920-80.jpg

Everyone loves an animated suit of armor. Much like with the Summer Mummy, however, there's some aesthetic work that needs to be done to bring the image in line with Deadlock's aesthetic theme. And much like with the Summer Mummy, I've identified a shorts-centric solution—boxing shorts, in this case. And boxing gloves. A plate armor prize fighter who could play like the third-person MOBA-shooter equivalent of Little Mac.

Now, you might ask, does Deadlock need yet another prize fighter when it already has Lash and Bebop? And to that I'd say: Neither of them has cartoonishly big shorts, do they? It's like you're not even paying attention.
Big spider
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/E5xe3H8JoXxq3wMxgjAyJD-1920-80.jpg

There was, admittedly, already an unreleased spider-themed hero during Deadlock's Hero Labs days, but frankly, why half-ass it? Just go full spider. Let it walk on all the surfaces. Give it eight weapons for each of its eight limbs. Is it really a videogame if there isn't a large enemy spider in there somewhere?
Big spider (sexy)
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/iXGXixGMVnRNnzfXNoSk2P-1920-80.jpeg
I can't take credit for this one:
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ffKTUYUJZvUDdCbNxmaz7J-1920-80.png
Humpty Dumpty
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pV3fEaM5EpYJbEqMGdTucm-1920-80.jpg

We all know the deal: on wall, great fall, horses and men prove inadequate at reconstructive surgery, etc. But I'm imagining this is the Humpty Dumpty that's had to go on living knowing the world failed him in his darkest moment—a sort of Punished "Venom" Dumpty situation. He's fighting in the Ritual not to restore his own broken form, but to create a world for other shattered eggs like himself. It's the kind of grim antihero that audiences crave.
And he could, like, roll around to attack sometimes, maybe. That's fun.
The rest of the monkey that the Monkey's Paw came off of
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/y8K84x9z9VbcShbyMtEvrS-1920-80.jpg

That thing had to come from somewhere, right? If the Paw can grant wishes, imagine what all the other parts of the enchanted monkey must be capable of. Surely, it must have been severed from the limb of a sort of simian arch-sorcerer, who possessed a command over magicks so profound as to reconfigure the flow of fate itself.
What I'm saying is he could shoot energy balls from his stump like it was a Mega Man arm cannon and it would rule. And maybe he does street magic in Times Square. For walking around money.
North Pole elf labor rights activist
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4d8wwx4dCxUHmsNFXMk3y7-1920-80.jpg

I think we've all known it for a long time: There's something untoward about the whole Santa Claus operation. We're meant to believe that an entire society is content with knowing no life beyond the ceaseless churn of toy production under the rule of a treat-crazed overlord? Really?

I don't buy it—and that's exactly why there's a hero who's ventured to New York to foster awareness and support for the plight of their fellows still trapped toiling at the Kringle company town up north. They could create a bunch of nutcracker soldiers as their ult, but they'd be nutcracker soldiers of the revolution.

One of the deer from Staten Island, but it was turned into a sapient anthropoid by some sort of cursed amulet and is struggling to adjust to city life on account of antlers making it hard to get into buildings
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/vHUcgxZXX7HiZWn4gSosTK-1920-80.jpg
Label sorta says it all, really.
Bigfoot (he is running for mayor)

It just makes sense. He's a compelling figure. He's all-American. He's privacy conscious and likely has a sensible platform regarding municipal walkability. He's been around long enough that he probably knows a few spells, and he's big enough that he could handle a Lewis gun like an airsoft rifle.
He'd have my vote, is what I'm saying. And the best part is: You'd be able to listen to the other heroes grill Bigfoot about his political stances. That's videogames to me.

news.title: Skate 开发者承诺 ReSkate 改装平台火爆后将推出更多创意工具
news.summary: Full Circle, the developer of Skate, published a statement addressing community mods following the viral launc

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/skate-developer-addresses-reskate-1791574192606.jpg
Full Circle, the developer of Skate, published a statement addressing community mods following the viral launch of a fan-made modding platform called ReSkate.

ReSkate was officially released into the wild about a week ago. This platform allows fans to play the game offline, create private servers, make their own maps, and more. It’s already been downloaded over 350,000 times on GitHub, and its creators are well-aware that they might get hit with a cease-and-desist order.

However, that doesn’t seem to be a problem — at least, not yet, but the devs at Full Circle aren’t exactly toothless about the situation, either. Full Circle published a statement acknowledging fan mods on October 9, where they admitted to the importance of community mods while also standing firm against those that bypass paid cosmetics or make money off of new features.

“Skateboarding in general is built on community and creative expression, and we support that. We love seeing your passion for pushing the limits of San Vansterdam in different ways. That's why we built our new skateboarding sandbox in San Vansterdam to begin with, to give you, the players, the tools you need to have fun and create amazing content,” it wrote.

“To be completely clear, we are not against creativity from players or stopping that from happening. Where we have to draw the line is when mods or other tools bypass our systems to unlock paid cosmetics, release gated/unreleased content, or profit from these unauthorized assets. That rips off the artists, skate brands, and creators, as well as our own development team here at Full Circle, who work hard to bring skate culture into our game.

Full Circle went on to confirm that it is aware that players want “more freedom and custom features,” and revealed that it’s currently building “official, secure access tools that enable broader, deeper community creation.” More news on this will be shared at a later date.
A message from the team at Full Circle regarding mods and community content. https://t.co/sTiTUvkRWX

ReSkate’s popularity is undeniable; after its release, Skate’s playerbase saw a massive jump in active players, peaking at over 7,000 players on October 5 — the highest it’s been for months after the game's launch in September 2025.
Speaking with PC Gamer , the developers of ReSkate admitted that they “honestly didn't realize how big this was going to be," saying they were “just doing it for the love of the game."

They also told the outlet that they are prepared to take ReSkate down if EA’s lawyers come knocking, which many fans are already assuming will happen at some point down the line. For now, though, ReSkate remains alive and well, and it has seemingly spurred Full Circle into taking action to give the game more community-friendly features.

news.title: 使命召唤：MW4抢先体验还包括DMZ，以下是如何进入
news.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable a week early for people who preorder, and now we know th

content.v: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable a week early for people who preorder, and now we know the DMZ mode will be as well.

Activision has announced that MW4's extraction-based DMZ mode will be playable starting Tuesday, October 20, which is three days before the game launches. Campaign early access, meanwhile, starts on October 16.
How to get in
To access DMZ mode before everyone else, you need to preorder any edition of MW4, including the standard or Vault versions. The perk applies to all platforms: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.
What is DMZ?

Described as the "definitive extraction shooter experience," DMZ in MW4 is an open-world game mode featuring other human players and AI combatants. Players will search the map for loot, craft gear, and complete objectives. Like in other extraction-based games, you need to reach the exfil point to make it out with all your rewards.

DMZ originally debuted with 2022's MW3 as a free-to-play beta inside Warzone, but this version left a lot to be desired. The new version of DMZ for MW4 seems like a big step up , and it includes a new social space this time as well.
For lots more, be sure to read up on GameSpot's previous coverage of the new version of DMZ .

news.title: 战争机器：E-Day——卖得怎么样？让我们打开包装
news.summary: Microsoft's latest console exclusive, Gears of War: E-Day , launched this week, and now we've gotten the first

content.v: Microsoft's latest console exclusive, Gears of War: E-Day , launched this week, and now we've gotten the first glimpse at how the game is performing commercially. Multiple analysts have weighed in, and there are numerous factors at play beyond pure sales, due to Game Pass and other factors. So let's break things down.

Rhys Elliott of Alinea Analytics released a report that said the game has sold about 230,000 copies so far, with Steam sales accounting for 168,000 and Xbox (across console and PC) making up the other 62,000.

Straight sales do not tell the whole story, though, because E-Day is available on Game Pass, which Elliott said "cannibalized" the majority of sales. He said Alinea's data showed than 1.7 million people acquired E-Day through their Game Pass subscription as opposed to buying a copy outright.

There is more nuance there, too, as Elliott said that 722,000 of the 1.7 million people who played E-Day through Game Pass bought the $30 Premium upgrade, which got them in early and awarded them with extra content.

"So despite selling far fewer copies on Steam, Xbox accounts for almost three-quarters of the revenue (roughly $26 million of the $37 million, versus about $11 million on Steam). So '230,000 copies' undersells the paying audience. Including the 722,000 upgrades, nearly 950,000 people actually paid something for E-Day."
Elliott concluded that these are "soft numbers" at a time "when Xbox badly needs revenue wins." In this environment, Elliott said E-Day's $70 edition is "functionally dead on Xbox."

"In a world without day-one Game Pass, many of these folks would have bought E-Day at $70. They paid $30 for five days early access to something they don’t own. Xbox is, in effect, charging its most valuable customers the least, based on a hangover from a tried-and-exhausted strategy from a previous administration," he said.
More to the story

Game Pass creates recurring revenue for Xbox, and it's big business. For the latest fiscal year, Game Pass brought in nearly $5 billion in revenue. E-Day's inclusion on Game Pass adds value to the service for Game Pass members.

However, Elliott said Game Pass is no longer growing, putting Xbox "at a crossroads." Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has alluded to this as well, saying Game Pass was one of Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond's big bets that did not pay off .
“Our core business weakened, and we added more teams, more investment, and more time, hoping for a better outcome,” she said.

Microsoft spent many billions of dollars acquiring numerous developers with the aim of funneling content to Game Pass. The strategy did not work , and now Xbox has made major changes to Game Pass, including removing the biggest day-one new release it ever had in the Call of Duty franchise. New releases are no longer included at launch, so players have to buy them outright or wait a year until they come to Game Pass.
"When a game this bloody awesome and well-reviewed [Gears of War: E-Day] does this softly on its home platform, the model--not the game--gets brought into question," Elliott said.

Mat Piscatella of Circana reminded people that E-Day's revenue was not totally cannibalized in practice through its inclusion on Game Pass because a person had to pay $23/month for Game Pass in the first place. Beyond that, Piscatella pointed out that that not everyone who played E-Day through Game Pass would buy the game outright if that was the only way.
What about a PS5 version?
Many people expected Microsoft to release E-Day on PS5, in part because Microsoft's own documents showed that a PS5 version was in the works and because Gears of War Reloaded came to PS5 a year ago.

A PS5 edition of E-Day was reportedly canceled at the last minute; Microsoft denied this, but no one believes that . Microsoft's Aaron Greenberg has said E-Day is not a timed exclusive for Xbox, meaning it may never come to PS5. However, he said the same thing about Starfield , and then it came to PS5, so people are understandably hesitant to believe what the company says.
Elliott previously said Gears of War: E-Day (along with Clockwork Revolution) are being sent out to die due to their exclusivity to Xbox. They are also coming to PC, but not PS5.
Elliott told GameSpot that Microsoft will never succeed in the console space and promising fans exclusive games to help drive console sales is not going to make a difference.

“Console as we know it is over for Xbox–and has been for a while. There’s no turning that ship. But they still need to pretend to care until they’ve transitioned to pastures where they can return to growth (if they succeed),” he said.

“A Gears console exclusive does not shift meaningful numbers of Series X units. Exclusivity as a hardware-driver is over for them, because the install base it would drive simply isn’t responsive enough to justify the cost of building hardware at a 5x component premium. And those games are on Steam anyway,” he added.
Elliott went on to say that Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork Revolution are “sacrificial lambs for hearts-and-minds, not economics.”
E-Day sequel possibilities

Will there be a sequel to E-Day? That remains to be seen, but The Coalition's Mike Crump said E-Day creates a "great foundation" for the franchise to grow. Crump also stated that a potential sequel could be made much faster. The studio has no other games in development that have been announced publicly.
Microsoft bought the Gears of War series from Epic in 2014 for an undisclosed sum.

There have been big changes at Xbox lately as part of Sharma's effort to "reset" the Xbox business and help it grow. This has included mass layoffs, studio closures, and game cancellations. Recently, Sharma said Xbox was at an " all time low" but is now growing again , though she didn't provide any data to support her claims.

news.title: 休闲套装拉里即将谢幕
news.summary: The Wet Dreams games have been marked down dramatically ahead of their final removal from sale.

content.v: 2018's Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Don't Dry was a genuinely pleasant surprise, in that it's actually good—quite a contrast to the preceding games in the series, Magna Cum Laude and Box Office Bust, which were decidedly not good. A sequel followed, Wet Dreams Dry Twice , and once again it was pretty good stuff—not hugely innovative or high art, but a genuine Leisure Suit Larry experience that manages to avoid embarrassing itself (though it embarrasses Larry himself plenty).

Both of them, sadly, are soon going away for good. An announcement on Steam from publisher Assemble Entertainment says both games are being removed from the store on October 23. Ahead of that, they're being offered seriously cheap: 95% off the regular price, dropping them to less than $2 each.
The removal of the Wet Dreams duo effectively puts a pin in a process than began in 2025, when the OG Larry games were removed from sale:
Leisure Suit Larry 4 managed to avoid the executioner's axe by not existing in the first place .

A reason for this new round of delistings wasn't provided, nor did Assemble comment on the possibility of an eventual return. Expiring licenses rights are a common culprit for this sort of thing, and that seems to be a good bet here: Leisure Suit Larry was originally a Sierra game, which I assume means Assemble licensed the property from Activision for the Wet Dreams duo; given the timing (Wet Dreams Don't Dry was announced in 2018), we're coming up on roughly 10 years since that deal would've been done, which, as someone who's bad at math and thus likes nice round numbers, seems to me like a reasonably possible expiration date for such a deal.

But that's entirely speculation. What's certain is that Leisure Suit Larry: Wet Dreams Don't Dry and Wet Dreams Dry Twice are going away for good, and ahead of that they're both really cheap on both Steam and GOG—the delisting announcement makes no mention of their fate on GOG but it's a safe assumption they'll be disappeared there, too—until they're gone. Get 'em while they're wet.

news.title: 我可能最终在 GTA 5 模组上走得太远了，该模组导入了《毁灭战士 2》的大部分内容
news.summary: Insert sick riff here.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

I really don't know how to build up to this one. Grand Theft Auto 5 is Doom now, okay? I put in a mod that imports DOOM2.wad into GTA 5 and now that's what the game is. There are demons. The game is first person. I have a minigun and a BFG. That's the truth of the matter and we're all just going to have to find some way to live with it.

The mod is Doom 2 in GTA 5 Hell On Earth (D2IGTA5HOE), and it does all those things I said. Hit F9 and the game you are playing shifts from GTA 5—usually a third-person open-world acting game—to Doom 2, an FPS from 1994. You need to provide your own .wad—everybody be cool. No one call the cops.

The world remains, mind you. You don't warp to Doom 2's levels. Instead, you roam Los Santos with an arsenal of weapons from id's seminal shooter (gross). You can take on taxis with your super shotgun, fight cops with a plasma cannon. It's two great tastes that taste incomprehensible together. Hit F10 and the game goes into Hell On Earth mode—authentic Doom 2 enemies start manifesting in the street.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/E7Ui9xMAry5SqtPnpTyUwL-1920-80.gif

One issue, of course, is that F10 is also my button for activating flossing and Superman mode, so I can't play Doom 2 GTA 5 Edition without a full quarter of my screen being taken up by a (still utterly Arabic) flossing UI screen and various Kryptonian powers sometimes activating. One of those is super speed when I sprint, though, which is at least appropriate for Doom Guy.
Anyway, here's a gif of me fighting demons and armed furries at an airport with Doom 2 weapons while a tornado closes in.

news.summary: Humble Bundle has dropped its October Humble Choice lineup, which features Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Haw

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/02/18/likeadragonhawaii-blogroll-1739839417413.jpg

With the arrival of October comes a brand new Humble Choice lineup for PC gamers to dig into, and it looks like a stacked selection this month. Leading the pack is Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii followed by Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown and Psychonauts 2 (which are all 8/10 games in our eyes), alongside five other PC games to add to your Steam library for just $14.99/month when you sign up to become a Humble Choice member.

That's a steal compared to buying all eight games on their own, but that's not all. One month free of IGN Plus is also thrown in the mix, plus you get some added shopping perks when you're a member, like up to 20% off in the Humble store. What a treat.
Humble Choice - October 2026
Humble Choice October 2026 Game List

As briefly mentioned above, quite a few games in this list have earned high praise from us in the past. Each has a very different experience to offer as well, so you can have a nice variety at your fingertips.

If you're looking to jump into an RPG, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii is a game IGN's Tristan Ogilvie called a, "delightful spin-off that seamlessly shifts between street thuggery and skulduggery" in his review . Or, if you prefer platformers, Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown can keep you company with a "fast and fun combat system, tight and satisfying controls, and stylish look and feel", per our review .

Psychonauts 2 is another game from this list that we adored, with IGN's Tom Marks calling it an "excellent successor to one of gaming’s most memorable action-platformers" in his review . On a personal level, I'm a huge fan of this delightful Double Fine sequel as well, and am always happy to recommend adding it to a gaming library.

These games are just the start of what's available with a Humble Choice membership, though. Alongside the eight total games you'll get for your PC library this month, you'll also get a month free of IGN Plus , which allows you to disable ads across the site, enjoy discounts at the IGN store, score free games, and much more.

Each month 5% of your Humble Choice membership will go towards a charity as well, which is a wonderful bonus to have with everything else above. This month, your money will be going towards HFC ( Hilarity for Charity ), which helps out families impacted by Alzheimer’s disease.

news.title: Wardogs 将用现金和 XP 贿赂玩家，让他们在第 2 赛季中选择蓝队
news.summary: "We're looking at how we can help the win rate of a certain team."

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/quGfuiKE7kHW9W8XDcB8yS.jpg
Blue team reinforcements

Bulkhead wants to boost one team's win rate, and it's willing to bribe its players (with in-game cash) to do it. Despite all three teams starting on equal grounds, many Wardogs players have been avoiding Blue from the start , going so far as to idle on the selection screen for minutes waiting for a slot to open on Green or Red.

The are practical balancing problems that work against Blue team, like their lackluster camouflage and unfavorable spawn points (Season 2 is tackling Bakurani), but the bonuses are meant to counter the other reason Blue sucks, as I covered last month:

"Another, less talked about possibility, is that Blue team's infamy is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Folks have one bad night with Lonestar and decide to believe the reputation, or hear it's the team to avoid, or notice everyone else actively avoiding it, and you end up with a Blue team full of less experienced players."

XP and cash bribes are a drastic move, but should have a real impact. It's unclear how big these boosts will be, but I expect Blue will instantly become the most popular team by a wide margin in Season 2.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/U9yqPBSZdjGNZrCFSwxKzH-1920-80.png

I wonder, though, if this problem wasn't slowly sorting itself out already. I've noticed the Blue bias dying down over the past couple weeks—the faction is still mostly losing in the NA West servers I frequent, but they're also scoring points and competing, which is a positive sign. I've even been on a couple of winning Blue teams, if you can believe it.

Wardogs Season 2 is shaping up to be bigger than I expected so soon after release. The October 15 patch also adds new guns, vehicles, rainy weather on all maps, and more to be revealed in the patch notes next week. It also marks the game's first progression wipe—everyone's going back to level 1.

news.title: 《战地 6》从第一天起就添加了粉丝们想要的东西
news.summary: EA and Battlefield Studios have unveiled more details on Battlefield 6 's upcoming Season 5, and it includes a

content.v: EA and Battlefield Studios have unveiled more details on Battlefield 6 's upcoming Season 5, and it includes a new feature that fans have wanted since day one: a proper server browser.

Battlefield did indeed launch with a server browser, but--considering how it only supported Portal mode--it wasn't the one fans wanted. One of the game's producers asked why players even want a full server browser. Now, in response to the feedback, Battlefield Studios is adding a proper server browser with the Season 5 update this December, allowing people to create their own servers and set rules like map rotation and other particulars . Classic-era Battlefield games had server browsers, and fans flocked to them because they could pick and choose exactly the maps and modes they wanted to play.

Season 5 rolls out in waves, beginning with Siege of Las Vegas on October 13, which adds two new maps: Vegas Strip and Area 51. For Battlefield 6's battle royale RedSec, Siege of Las Vegas adds a new version of the mode called Rapid Royale, which promises faster rounds with smaller player populations.

Battlefield 6's Season 5 will also include a Halloween event running October 20 through November 7, featuring a "limited-time scenario" that has players hunting down "secret tech" beneath Area 51. This scenario, which Battlefield Studios stressed is non-canon, includes a celebration of aliens and the Dead Space series, taking players to environments based on the 2023 remake. There will also be Dead Space-themed cosmetics to unlock.

Phase 2 of Season 5, called Casino Heist, begins November 10, adding a new map called European Casino. Finally, Phase 3, known as Frozen Aces, arrives on December 8, and as its name suggests, it will bring cold weather to Las Vegas, along with a new operation across the Vegas Strip and Area 51. The Battlefield 6 server browser also arrives during the Phase 3 of Season 5 .
Battlefield 6 was 2025's best-selling game in the US , even outperforming Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
