news.title: Wardogs 开发人员解释了为什么蓝队输得更多，并确认了在第二季中解决平衡问题的计划
news.summary: The team behind Wardogs has confirmed that Lonestar, AKA the blue team, loses more than other teams and is mak

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/s02-patchnotes-flakpanzer-gepard-1791560561425.png
The team behind Wardogs has confirmed that Lonestar, AKA the blue team, loses more than other team, and is making big changes in Season 2 to fix that.

Since Wardogs launched in early September, there have been no shortage of memes mocking the game's blue team, Lonestar. For whatever reason, Lonestar tends to lose a lot, and there are a plethora of videos showing Lonestar players crashing helicopters at base and making fools of themselves.

Speaking exclusively with IGN, Bulkhead confirmed that Lonestar's win percentage is lower than other teams in Wardogs, but it has actually increased over time. Lonestar's win rate was roughly 10% during the game's alpha, but has risen to 20% in recent weeks. Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott noted that this is partially a result of players choosing to support Lonestar because they see it as an underdog challenge. He even joked that blue team's reputation was a bit of a PR issue.

"So originally, and this is key to not misquote, it was like 10% in the alpha," he said. "So that then led to the perception: blue is bad, don't join blue. And then everyone tries to click on green and click on red because they're competitive and they want to win. So they're going on the better team. More recently, it's closer to 15 to 20%. It's probably closer to 20% right now, where people have actively been joining blue team to try and make them win, which is quite entertaining to watch. But it's undeniable, they are losing more than the other two teams because of that perception."

Bulkhead is taking steps to remedy this with the launch of Season 2 next week . The biggest change is that they are adjusting spawns and rebuilding bases for all teams on the map Bakurani. Senior producer Kane Allard noted that blue team's reputation may have been compounded by the fact that they were losing significantly more on Bakurani, possibly due to map issues. As a result, they've chosen to shake up all of the spawns.

"We've moved all three spawns, so it's not just blue team have moved," said Allard. "It's blue, red, and green. They've all moved. The actual hot zone of Bakurani hasn't been changed. It's just the spawn zones. It's kind of revitalized the map, and we've seen from a data standpoint with our internal tests that it has evened it out. But yeah, as Howard said, there is a genuine PR issue with Lonestar, and there are a few extra things that we're going to be doing to hopefully help turn the tide of that, as well."

Some of those "few extra things" include changing the saturation on Lonestar's uniforms so they can blend in better, cash and XP bonuses for playing and winning as Lonestar, and even posters in the other teams' spawns encouraging other players to switch to blue team.
"Yeah, we are doing some fun stuff," said Philpott. "We're even putting posters like 'Lonestar needs you,' in the other teams' spawns. So yeah, it should be good fun."

In a press conference, Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer joked that, "if you're not playing blue team, you are in fact, a pu**y." So with that said, it is now up to the players to take these buffs and changes to try and change the perception of Lonestar.
Wardogs Season 2 launches on October 15.

news.title: Wardogs 开发者因 Xbox Series S 的原因而推迟了某些功能，但致力于“极低端硬件”有其好处
news.summary: The developer of Wardogs has admitted that the limitations of the Xbox Series S have stopped it from adding ce

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2022/11/30/seriess-1624390081463-1669817083526.jpg

The developer of Wardogs has admitted that the limitations of the Xbox Series S have stopped it from adding certain things to the game, but insisted these limits have also provided some unique benefits.

During a press conference for Wardogs Season 2, Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer said the team is "limited" by the Xbox Series S and revealed that this is one of the reasons why the game doesn't have dynamic weather right now. The new rain feature being added to Wardogs this month will be persistent throughout a match, meaning a storm won't suddenly roll through halfway through a game and lighten up within 15 minutes. It's a constant downpour.

"We are limited, as every dev is, by Xbox Series S," said Brammer. "As great a platform as Xbox is, it's a very low-end hardware for a game like Wardogs. We have to be mindful of these things we're putting in the game now. Performance is the reason we don't do it, but we would love to see it at some point. There's an ambition for it, but nobody is working on it right now."

Bulkhead isn't the first team to acknowledge difficulties around Microsoft's cheaper console, which launched alongside the Xbox Series X in November 2020. Moon Studio founder Thomas Mahler stated earlier this year that it was delaying No Rest for the Wicked's Xbox release due to troubles with the Xbox Series S . Baldur's Gate 3 also came to Xbox a few months late and required the help of Microsoft's engineers to get the game's split-screen co-op working on Series S .

Indeed, one of the questions facing Microsoft ever since the release of the Xbox Series S is whether it would be willing to allow developers and publishers to release a game on Xbox Series X only, leaving Xbox Series S behind. As it stands, Xbox mandates that video games launch on both or none at all, and that there should be main feature parity between each version.

Although Wardogs isn't coming to console until 2028 , Bulkhead is hyper-aware of how everything it puts in the game could impact consoles in the future. In a follow-up interview exclusive to IGN, studio co-founder Howard Philpott echoed sentiments about possibly adding dynamic weather in the future, but noted Bulkhea would have to handle it carefully to avoid tanking performance. He added that, while Series S has its pitfalls, it also lets the developer optimize the game for lower-end PCs.

"As for Series S, Joe is right, and it's not an industry secret or anything," he said. "It is holding back what developers can do in terms of pushing the boundaries because it's so far behind par in terms of the rest of the power of the rest of the consoles. So yeah, it's something we have to be cognizant of, but at the same time, Series S does actually give us that baseline performance.

"We were so heavy [during] pre-release in terms of talking about performance for PC, and what we didn't necessarily talk about [during the] press conference was how much Series S drove us to make the performance good on lower-spec PCs, because the goal is to get everyone to be able to play with all of their friends. There's an obvious financial benefit to that, so it's not completely altruistic, but at the same time, it is the goal. That is the point of the game: being able to play with as many people as possible."

Philpott also noted that Bulkhead has always imagined Wardogs as a multi-platform game. The team recognized there was heavy demand for controller support prior to Wardogs' early access launch, prompting them to quickly put something together. He stated that this support is in "an okay serviceable state, but really it needs to be a lot better." Senior producer Kane Allard noted that situation has prompted Bulkhead to be more "forward thinking."

"I think that's a good example of one of the things that bit us a bit and made us realize actually we do need to be forward thinking," said Allard. "We made the decision, as Howard said, originally we were releasing on PC for early access, and it was kind of an afterthough, we need to have controller support. And then we realized there was a massive outcry for it, and we had to look back at the systems we had and try and make them work with controller, and there was a fair amount of work there. And yeah, we did do it in the end and it was a little bit of a slog, but that did burn us a bit. And we then realized, yeah, we need to be really smart, build stuff with console in mind, with controller in mind, and we're taking that forward for everything that we put in the game."

It will be a while before Wardogs makes its way to consoles, but this is a major part of the game's journey. Philpott also said that Bulkhead hired a pro Halo player to help with controller support and ensuring that it gets an extra level of care.
Wardogs Season 2 will launch next week on October 15.

news.title: Wardogs 开发人员表示 PS6 和 Xbox Project Helix 端口应该相对简单
news.summary: The team behind Wardogs expects to bring the game to next-gen consoles in the future.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/09/25/ps5-pro-handsonpreview-blogroll-1727223976585.jpg
The team behind Wardogs expects to bring the game to next-gen consoles in the future.

Although some would argue that this console generation has yet to meet its full potential, platform holders are already ramping up for the next one with Sony's PlayStation 6 and Xbox's Project Helix, though neither company has locked in an official release window. However, it does mean some developers have to start planning ahead, and one of those studios is Bulkhead, the team behind the new shooter Wardogs.

In an exclusive interview with IGN, we talked about plans for the game's eventual console release. Wardogs is currently slated to make the jump to consoles in 2028 , which begs the question: Will it release on next-gen hardware? Bulkhead says it's not even really a question.

"I think there's not too much to consider," said Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott. "We make the game performant, we're going to get it on the next-gen consoles. From our perspective, it's a straight port. So yeah, absolutely is the short answer, to be honest."

Senior producer Kane Allard noted that Bulkhead is already speaking with platform holders about the console versions of Wardogs, and doesn't anticipate any issues bringing the game to next-gen machines.

"We're obviously already in conversation with the proprietors of those platforms, and they're going to have certain criteria that we have to match, and I assume it's going to be the same for those other consoles as well. So from our perspective, if we get it on a base Xbox or base PlayStation, it shouldn't be much more work to get it on next-gen, and it should just be more performance. So I don't think it gives us anything new."

Last month, former PlayStation Worldwide Studios boss Shuhei Yoshida said Sony and Nintendo should make their current consoles last as long as possible amid soaring costs that have already prompted PS5 and Switch 2 price rises. Yoshida told The Verge that console companies needed to focus on sustaining their current hardware platforms for "as long as possible."

We know that a PS6 is on the way at some point . Previously, analysts had suggested a 2028 launch seemed likely, though Sony is yet to make any official indication of when PS6 may arrive — and as time goes on, that late 2028 release date feels less and less likely .

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has insisted Project Helix remains part of Microsoft's gaming plan, but has also said next-gen Xbox hardware will be a "family of devices." "We are moving to a family of devices for Gen-10," she said in a memo reported by Windows Central . "There is not one device that fits all. We will certainly have a great console first, but we also know that many players will be on the go. There are some things that we are the best in the world to manufacture, and there are other things that will we partner on. So, we will be sharing more about that as our plans develop. The operating system is starting to look really good. We're very excited about this."

For now, anyone looking to play Wardogs will have to check out the PC version, which is currently in early access. Next week sees the launch of Season 2 , which will introduce major gameplay features such as rain.

news.title: Wardogs 的新降雨系统将对第二季的游戏玩法产生重大影响
news.summary: Wardogs developer Bulkhead has revealed how rain will change the gameplay in Season 2.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/s02-trailer-stills1-1791560517450.png
Wardogs developer Bulkhead has revealed how rain will change the gameplay in Season 2.

Next week, Wardogs will release its second season of content, which will also add rain to the game. This will not be dynamic weather, so don't expect it to be sunshine one minute and storming the next; matches that include rain will experience rainfall the entire time, from start to finish. However, this will result in some major changes to the game, with senior producer Kane Allard confirming to IGN that it "completely changes the game," and as a result, some players may not actually like this addition.

"It completely changes the game, and it's going to be positive for some players," said Allard. "It's going to be negative for others. Your play styles might be affected. That's okay. It's not like every map's going to be permanently rain. It's just going to be almost like a different game mode, so to speak. [It] could be that some people really love rain, some people really hate rain based on how you want to play. But it does bring a lot."

As for how things change, it's pretty drastic. The map is obviously darker, and your visibility is worsened. One developer even stated that he lost his sense of direction on the map because he wasn't used to the way it looked now. The storms will cause thunder, which can be strategically used to mask gunfire or other loud noises. Raindrops will make different sounds based on the surfaces they're hitting, including rooftops and helmets. Windows will also fog up, though it's unclear if that allows players to be less visible when hiding in buildings. The team has also accounted for destruction, meaning if a roof is destroyed, players inside will be exposed to the rain.

As for other weather effects, Bulkhead isn't ruling anything out, but it has to consider how something like snow would change the game both in terms of gameplay and how the game performs. Bulkhead CEO Joe Brammer stated that there are obvious changes to something like nighttime, which would add flashlights, NVGs, and lasers. Maybe one day we'll get more, but it sounds like it may take some time to get added.
We've got plenty more on Wardogs, including Bulkhead on why blue team loses more, a new gambling mechanic for Season 2, and even word of a next-gen port. Wardogs Season 2 launches on October 15.

news.title: Wardogs 第 2 季增加了新的赌博机制，让你可以自己下注
news.summary: Wardogs Season 2 is adding a new gambling system which will allow players to bet on their own performance.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/09/s02-trailer-stills3-1791560662296.png
Wardogs Season 2 is adding a new gambling system that will allow players to bet on their own performances.

The new season of Wardogs, due to launch on October 15, features a bunch of new content, most notably a new weather system that adds rain to matches . Another major mechanic lets players win big, or lose tons of cash. It's called the Wager Vendor, and it allows players to bet on themselves. If you think you can kill 20 people in a match, make a bet, and you will be rewarded. However, if you fail, you will lose cash. The harder your challenge is, the more you stand to win.

Speaking exclusively to IGN about the new system, developer Bulkhead noted that it technically won't be available to players as soon as the season launches, as they'll have to unlock it by building up cash.

"The Wager Vendor basically lets you bet on your own performance," said Bulkhead co-founder Howard Philpott. "So if I want to go in and say, 'I'm going to get 20 kills this match,' you then set that in your Wager Vendor, you then set the condition so I can say, 'Oh, I need to go and kill 20 people with my fists.' Okay, that's a bit harder, but that's when the odds go up. And then you set that as a condition and you can add multiple conditions."
"If you're a really good player and you're really smart about building your wager, you can make big money, but you can also lose big money," added senior producer Kane Allard.
Players can get pretty specific with these wagers. However, the more restrictions you put on yourself, the harder it will be to accomplish.

"Conditions-wise, it can even go down to as minute as, 'I need to get five kills, they're all head shots, all with the AK74M, and they all have to be in the hot zone, and my loadout has to cost less than 20K,'" said Allard. "You can build that wager and you can maybe earn double of what you put down, but that's a lot of restrictions that you're putting on yourself, and there's going to be players that may be also trying the same thing, and it just adds a little bit more tension to the game."

This not only spices up the gameplay, but it can also be extremely rewarding for players who are trying to build up some cash. If you're playing medic, you could theoretically give yourself a bonus for reviving 30 players. This then incentivizes medics to help their team more. It'll be intersting to see how this changes player behavior, but it sounds like it could be a lot of fun.

Call of Duty had a far less detailed version of this system in 2010's Call of Duty: Black Ops. Players could unlock items with an in-game currency and go into high stakes party games, such as Gun Game and One in the Chamber, to try and earn more money. GTA Online also has a betting system, allowing players to bet on players they think will perform best in PvP modes.

Battlefield 6 is getting a Dead Space event in time for Halloween. EA and Dice are calling it a “non-canon” event, which means the Battlefield 6 developer can go wild with it. Necromorphs in Area 51? Why not?

The Dead Space and Battlefield 6 crossover was teased earlier in the week, with the alien monument The Marker showing up at the end of the shooter’s Vegas trailer. Pax Armata will be pursuing secret tech hidden beneath Area 51 in the event, which will be decked out with assets taken from the Dead Space remake .
Players will be able to unlock unique cosmetics for participating, starting when the event goes live on October 20. You’ll have until November 7 to grab what you want.

“Battlefield 6 is now one year old and what an incredible journey it’s been, from our Top Gun collaboration, which coincided with the return of Naval Warfare, to the launch of some of the most exhilarating maps in Battlefield history,” Battlefield Studios general manager Patrick Klaus said.

news.title: 《街头霸王》已经濒临死亡，玩家也不再年轻
news.summary: Street Fighter 5 launched in 2016 in rough shape, and if things hadn't changed, the classic fighting game fran

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2025/08/04/sf6-outfits-blog-1754304622675.jpg

Street Fighter 6 producer Shuhei Matsumoto revealed how dire things were for Capcom’s flagship fighting game franchise during the Street Fighter V era and explained how he and director Takayuki Nakayama worked together to save the series from death.

It’s no secret that Street Fighter V stumbled massively when it launched in February 2016. Many players felt that it was shipped out in an unfinished state, as it lacked basic elements like an arcade mode or story mode, on top of its incredibly unstable netplay.

Shuhei Matsumoto — who stepped in as producer for Street Fighter V near the end of its lifetime following Yoshinori Ono’s exit from Capcom in 2020 — alongside director Takayuki Nakayama, recognized that the franchise as a whole was in peril, and believed that the Street Fighter IP might actually fade into obscurity within the next decade if they didn’t act fast.

"When the two of us were talking during Street Fighter V, we realized that if we didn't do something about Street Fighter, the Street Fighter IP would probably die in 10 years. It was critical. So, we had to make it a game where people would get to know it all over again and play it again,” Matsumoto said during an October 2026 interview with Karin Ohira .
Matsumoto explained that SFV’s aging playerbase was one example of this issue, saying Capcom needed to target younger players if it wanted Street Fighter to live.

"At that time, the player base for Street Fighter V was roughly 35 to 45 years old. In 10 years, these people will be 60. It’s difficult to sustain the franchise if we only rely on that group,” he continued.

"...It had become a distant presence. People knew of the scene, but weren't actually playing the game, which made us think, 'This is bad.' In the end, we're a game company, yet people weren't playing our game. Isn't that the most fatal thing? So that was the biggest danger. We didn't know if those people would continue with the same level of passion, and naturally, there's a lifespan to things, right? That's when we talked about how, if we left it as it was, the IP would likely die in 10 years."

So, how did they manage to turn things around so dramatically with Street Fighter 6 ? Matsumoto said that the team avoided relying on its power as a historic IP, and decided to start with a blank slate, as if no one in the current generation knew about it, at all.

"While people say Street Fighter has high name recognition, we shouldn't be overconfident. We decided to act as if the current generation doesn't know us. We have to properly explain things to those who are just starting to play games now — like who these characters are and how to play — so we don't take that familiarity for granted."

Matsumoto also said that the development of SF6's Modern control scheme was integral to reaching a new audience, alongside other approachable features like World Tour Mode (which has since been paused for the forseeable future), the Battle Hub, and real-time commentary from community figures like Vicious and Tasty Steve.

Matsumoto and Nakayama’s plan paid off big time; Street Fighter 6 is one of Capcom’s most successful Street Fighter games of all time, having sold more than seven million lifetime units as of summer 2026. It’s extremely popular both in Japan and abroad, and boasts a massive playerbase across both Steam and consoles.

It’s a big year for Street Fighter fans and Capcom in general; the developer has released three critically-acclaimed titles in Resident Evil Requiem , Pragmata , and Onimusha: Way of the Sword , and is gearing up for the Street Fighter movie on October 16, which comes on the heels of the Resident Evil adaptation directed by horror savant Zach Cregger.

news.title: 全球 PC 出货量暴跌超过 20%，这绝对没有人感到意外
news.summary: Could it be something to do with.... the memory crisis?

content.v: IDC Research has released its figures regarding worldwide PC shipments in the third quarter of 2026, and would you believe it, they've dropped considerably. Looking at the year-over-year numbers, the shipped units dropped from 78.5 million in Q3 2025, to 62.7 million in Q3 of this year. That's a 20.1% plummet, for percentage fans.

But why, I hear you asking. Actually, I don't. The memory and supply chain crisis, driven by AI server demand is pinpointed by the IDC as the primary driver of the decline, which will come as no surprise to those of us in non-rock-based abodes.

However, it's worth looking a bit deeper into exactly what's happened here. The "pull-in" of stock created by vendors buying up supply in the first half of this year (in anticipation of the forecasted price hikes) has essentially borrowed volume from the second half, according to the report. As a result, this boosted the early year shipments and "left Q3 starved of demand."

"The result is a broken seasonal pattern: the third quarter is normally larger than the second, and this year it fell short," says the IDC. It's bad out there folks—and this report predicts that things might get gloomier for the industry in the near future.

"Channel concern over high inventory and soft demand at elevated prices could bring promotions in the near term, but pricing will stay well above year-ago levels," the report continues. "The bigger risk is macro: conditions have worsened since last quarter, and a weaker economic backdrop could push demand lower and darken the outlook for the remainder of 2026 and into 2027"
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/MgyYMxJjwmrmG9bY7mRfVg-1920-80.jpg

I love writing good news stories. It's a shame I don't get a whole lot of them these days. My heart almost leapt when I read this quote from IDC research director Jitesh Ubrani: "Channels are now worried about carrying too much inventory into a market where high prices are suppressing demand. That could translate into promotions and some short-term relief for consumers..."

Then dropped again at the second half of the sentence: "... but we don’t expect pricing anywhere near what it was a year ago. Prices will remain elevated. With macro conditions worsening, the risk is that the outlook for the next few quarters gets worse before it gets better."

Anyway, the report also points out that this economic pain was not felt evenly, as Lenovo, HP, and Dell fell faster than the market and collectively lost 4.2 points of share, with HP being the hardest hit, dropping from 19.1% to 16.5%.

Lenovo is still the biggest shipper of PCs overall , though, and the three companies keep their same positions in the rankings as they did this time last year, with HP coming in second and Dell in third. In fourth position is Apple, which has also seen an 11.3% drop in growth, and in fifth place comes Asus, with its own growth figures dropping by 8.6%.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NRiuWJ8YersHWaELvtB9vj-1920-80.jpg

Well, I don't think any of us can say we're shocked to hear this news. With the crisis continually predicted to worsen from those in the know, (like Micron's CEO, who recently took the opportunity to ram that point home over and over again ), it looks like PC pricing is screwed for a while to come yet. "Promotions are possible," the report handily sums up. "However, prices are expected to remain elevated and well above where they were at the same time last year."

In a totally unrelated question, did you buy a PC recently, and are you interested in letting it go for a reasonable sum? Asking for a friend. No pressure, take your time, I can wait here, etc, etc. Got any spare memory modules while we're at it?

news.title: Valve 正在通过真实世界数据告诉开发者他们的游戏在 Steam Deck 上的实际运行情况
news.summary: Here's hoping devs actually use those figures to improve compatibility.

content.v: Have you ever clicked on a Steam Deck Verified game, attempted to boot it up, and realised it probably shouldn't have been verified? Well, Steam's new system should help developers give a more accurate understanding of how their games run on the Steam Deck.

As of October 1 (via TechPowerUp ), Valve has given developers access to frame rate data as reported by Steam Deck users. A developer can see the frame rate that users are playing at as a percentage of sessions, meaning they can see if it runs well (at the Steam Deck's usual 60/90 fps cap) or not (users are generally lowering the fps limit).

That does mean it's only data willingly shared, and there are some caveats. The LCD Steam Deck has a max refresh rate of 60, while the OLED model goes up to 90. As games are often capped for fps to save resources, that will shape the stats somewhat. In addition, it can't guarantee how Steam Deck owners use their devices.

That being said, giving access to a high enough volume of data means that the fps averages should balance out in a bell curve, assuming enough players opt in. Valve claims "a majority of Steam Deck players have opted in".

The major benefit of this update is that developers can see how their games run on a mass of Steam Decks, and therefore adjust graphical options. This could be particularly valuable in games like Cyberpunk 2077 that have a dedicated Steam Deck mode. If developers notice those on handhelds aren't getting 60 fps or can't hit a smooth 30 average fps, they might tweak the settings a tad.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/kLev9og6m9wsaoHX9JDQMU-1920-80.jpg
Valve has even explained that Steam Deck data is just a "starting point for iteration as we learn what sorts of data and presentation are useful."

That means, if successful, other devices could get the same data grouping. If enough Legion Go S users submit their data, or sales of the Steam Machine are high enough, it could get valuable data to developers.
This is, however, assuming that developers will tweak games for these devices. It only works for verified games, so it can't be used as part of the verification process as of right now.

Still, if mass reports of poor performance on Steam Deck start coming in for verified games, this means devs can really dig into the numbers to see what the average player is experiencing. Devs can then see in real time where updates positively or negatively impact performance. More data is always a good thing in my book.

news.title: GTA 6 会登陆 Switch 2 吗？任天堂表示，请询问 Rockstar
news.summary: Rockstar's GTA 6 is the biggest game of 2026 and possibly ever, but it's not coming to Switch 2 ... or is it?

content.v: Rockstar's GTA 6 is the biggest game of 2026 and possibly ever, but it's not coming to Switch 2 ... or is it? Nintendo of America's new president, Devon Pritchard, was recently asked if GTA 6 is coming to Switch 2, and she didn't say yes or no. Instead, she said people should ask Rockstar and its owner, Take-Two.
“That’s going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,” Pritchard told Variety .

In May of 2025, a report from NateTheHate said Rockstar was conducting tests to see about bringing GTA 6 to Switch 2 . He clarified that this doesn't mean GTA 6 was planned for Switch 2, going on to say developers regularly conduct tests to see if their games are technically feasible on different platforms.
For now, GTA 6 is confirmed only for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S when it launches on November 19. History suggests that a PC edition will follow later, but this is not confirmed.

CEO Strauss Zelnick said the company could bring more games to Switch 2, but it's unknown if GTA 6 may be among them. He said Take-Two “would not necessarily bring every title to the platform,” but he noted there is a “great” opportunity to bring some of its older titles to Switch 2. He also said he is a “big believer” in the Switch 2.

While GTA 6 may not be coming to Switch 2, Rockstar released GTA: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition on Switch in 2021, and it's playable on Switch 2 as well. Before this, Rockstar released GTA: Chinatown Wars for Nintendo DS. GTA 1 and GTA 2 also came to the Game Boy back in the day.

两个月前，他和夏鸣前恋爱（我们姑且算作是恋爱关系），算上转账和奢侈品等至今已经砸了快30万。人虽说是凿到了（当事人表示很爽）、房子也是自己给她租的，然而日常聊天却逐渐出了问题：一聊天就是爱答不理，出门就失联，问就是“回老家”“跟闺蜜在一起”……久而久之，当事人觉得不对劲，于是摇人线下突袭了其住处。
随后，突袭者在线下找到了一大兜子的——
拦精灵。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261009_lcx_581_1/13178.jpg
《开始匹配》
这还没完，突袭者发现，夏鸣前的住处抽屉与行李箱中还藏有大量拍立得照片，里面摆放着她和各路男士的亲密合照——从薄肌男到肥宅、从眼镜男到中登算得上样样都有，根据当事人的表示，部分照片里甚至还有男方的……作案工具。
最难蚌的，是叮当猫本人的态度：他表示，最气的不是女方有亲密合照这事儿本身，而是这一群亲密合照的男人里面，竟然没有他。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261009_lcx_581_1/13674.jpg
上亿投资，多方合作，只为给你最佳体验
那还说啥了兄弟，尊重理解祝福嘲笑就完了呗。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261009_lcx_581_1/14039.jpg
乐子发生后，有人把将夏鸣前比作前一阵爆火的青楼女子林翩翩——但我说句实话，这么比有点辱林了，起码后者对自己的经历还还不藏着掖着，而且你掏个30万还能拿个永久霸福。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261009_lcx_581_1/14443.jpg
东窗事发后，夏鸣前的一位前男友联系上了叮当猫。根据前者表示，女方貌似有收集癖，此前至少收集过50个人头，基本涵盖市面上各种类型。对于叮当猫来说，这就相当于玩海斗开局出门领先50个骰子，一动身上全是帽子。
尽管我认为这“50人”可能存在夸张的说法，在这一刻，漫展上常说的集邮有了别样的含义。
叮当猫be like
而整起事件中节目效果最足的，还属昨晚叮当猫和up主鬼蜀黍、棉花大哥哥以及一众工作室成员的一场线下直播。
在直播间，弹幕在攻击主播、出镜的其他哥们在疯狂憋笑，而画面中的男主角看似云淡风轻水泥封心，实则平均五分钟就要超雄体质发作并狂暴怒吼一番，精神状态堪称极度美丽。
直播中，知名二游区up主棉花曾试图用二游的抽卡理论劝导叮当猫：谈恋爱就像玩二游，要抽限定up池不要抽常驻池，毕竟常驻池质量都不咋地。
然后一旁的鬼蜀黍接了一句，叮当猫就喜欢玩成品号。
在直播即将结束时，一个弹幕飘过：“是剧本吗？”
叮当猫用四字回应：
随后他说，要是剧本的话你来当主角，我和你女朋友友情演一下，攻击力十足
而当提及那一百来个套子时，这几个人考虑的处理方式是——要不抽了吧。
只是对此，吃瓜群众的绝大多数反应都不是同情，是嘲笑，那种无穷无尽的嘲笑。
首先，这个事件太符合大众对于cos圈的刻板印象。
众所周知，cos这个圈子是个“好女孩”辈出的地方（各种含义上），哪怕有一些coser确实口碑很好，也掩盖不了整个圈子就是摊烂泥的事实：且不说部分职业道德为0的专业人士，不少所谓的coser套了个假发+cos服就开始抬价，一边搞擦边卖肉、一边追求女性独立，且背后往往还有不止一个金主——当代互联网，一般管这种人叫做“契约兽”。
虽说在这起事件中，男方女方之间的关系可能还有点猫腻：毕竟俩月砸30万，你很难说这是什么正常的恋爱关系——但甭管是哪种关系，“职业道德败坏”和“道德败坏”这两顶帽子，她总得选一个扣上。她的过往履历也被人翻出来，成为大众笑柄：她在互联网上的留痕，全被收集起来成了日后的回旋镖。
而对于男方来说，这种嘲笑就很简单：大伙儿都知道的事，你怎么还当冤大头呢？
其次，叮当猫身上的回旋镖太多了。
在2023年，他似乎迎来了一次龙场悟道。
那年12月，他在当代压抑教父峰哥的视频下方，留下一则人生感悟：“给女神当沸羊羊是没用的。你花再多钱舔一百遍，人也不会回头看你一眼。自尊自爱自信，是每个人的人生必修课”。
这话倒没错，但显然猫哥没能通过自己开的课程，必修课挂科了。
类似的这种回旋镖，不止一处。
在两个月前，这哥们曾经发布一爆氪视频，叫作《爆氪30万打水漂！追求极品神宠到底有多难？梦幻合宠太疯狂了！》，似乎已经冥冥之中有所预言；
就在今天，他还发布了最新氪金力作，标题为《爆氪10万合宠成小丑》，封面带着个鲜明的小丑图标，似乎在嘲笑自己。
而来看热闹的人们不语，只是一味询问夏鸣前那一兜子的拦精灵到底哪款好用。
《小丑牌》里有一句话，放在这里刚好合适：看样子我们找到了谁是真的小丑。
而当把时间再往前推五年，我们还能发现一些乐子：
在2019～2022年，b站有个情感账号颇有热度，叫“喝水少年孙十一”。这个账号之前最火的内容，是yy各路男女情感的小故事。
——什么样的情感故事呢？
龟男被渣女钓，然后被绿的故事；当舔狗然后下场悲惨的故事；被同桌班花表白结果最后be的故事……
孙十一的代表作，有《舔狗教学：6年老舔狗手把手教你如何舔到女朋友》《校园险恶——我被美女社长白嫖当工具人的故事》等等，当时的弹幕，时常飘过一片绿色。

news.title: PS6发售时间又生变 曝最晚可能推迟到2029年
news.summary: 关于索尼次世代游戏主机PlayStation 6（PS6）的消息近期引发关注。业内消息人士TCMFGames总结了关于这款主机潜在发售时间的分析和爆…

content.v: 关于索尼次世代游戏主机PlayStation 6（PS6）的消息近期引发关注。业内消息人士TCMFGames总结了关于这款主机潜在发售时间的分析和爆料。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092256064163.png
其指出，近期，网络上流传着PS6可能于2027年下半年发售的说法。相关观点认为，距离主机正式上市可能已不足14个月，并将生产方面的相关信息作为依据。
不过，部分硬件分析师和业内人士对此持谨慎态度。知名爆料人Moore’s Law Is Dead等人指出，2027年一直是外界此前预测的时间节点，但PS6实际发售时间仍可能推迟至2028年，甚至不排除延后至2029年的可能。
造成这一情况的原因之一，是游戏主机的制造成本，以及半导体、内存等关键零部件的价格。与此同时，现有PlayStation主机系列目前仍保持着一定的销量，这也意味着索尼未必需要急于推动新一代主机上市。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092256165250.jpg
截至目前，索尼尚未就PS6的开发进度和生产计划发表官方声明。
外界普遍认为，PS6的具体规格与硬件架构等信息，可能要等到现有PlayStation平台的商业生命周期进入后期阶段，才会得到更全面的披露。因此，目前有关发售时间的消息，仍应视为业内人士和爆料者的预测，而非官方确认的信息。
对于PS6而言，2027年可能公布与2027年正式发售，是两个需要区分的概念。 即使索尼在2027年正式公布这款主机，也不能排除其实际发售时间推迟至2028年，甚至2029年的可能。

news.title: 任天堂女总裁回应《GTA6》上NS2：这事得问R星
news.summary: 任天堂美国总裁德文·普里查德（Devon Pritchard）近日接受Variety采访时，分享了公司的部分发展规划，她的战略核心之一，是充分利…

content.v: 任天堂美国总裁德文·普里查德（Devon Pritchard）近日接受Variety采访时，分享了公司的部分发展规划，她的战略核心之一，是充分利用Switch 2相对年轻的产品生命周期。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092250596720.png
与初代Switch相比，Switch 2拥有更出色的画面表现和更强的处理性能，能够支持全新的玩法形式。普里查德解释称：“这为开发者提供了更多不同的创作方向，让他们能够打造只能在Switch 2上体验到的游戏内容。”
Switch 2于2025年6月发售，截至目前累计销量已超过2300万台。任天堂已经为该平台推出数百款游戏，既包括《马里奥赛车 世界》等第一方热门作品，也有《生化危机 安魂曲》等第三方游戏。
Switch 2性能的提升，也是微软旗下动视决定将《使命召唤》系列带回任天堂主机的重要原因之一。这也是该系列时隔十多年再次登陆任天堂平台。今年秋季，《使命召唤：现代战争4》将与Xbox和PlayStation版本同步推出Switch 2版。这显然释放出一个信号：任天堂的新主机同样有能力驾驭节奏紧张的动作射击游戏。
那么，Switch 2能否容纳《GTA6》这样的成人向大作？这款游戏因包含成人内容和主题而被评为M级，将于11月发售，也是今年最受期待的游戏作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092251287451.jpg
从硬件性能来看，Switch 2确实具备运行M级游戏《GTA6》的潜力，但普里查德目前仍未透露这款游戏是否会登陆任天堂平台。
在采访中她回应了《GTA6》登陆NS2平台的问题：“这需要由Take-Two和Rockstar来讨论。目前我这边没有任何可以公布的消息。”普里查德说道。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092251063435.png
除了充分挖掘Switch 2在生命周期初期的潜力，普里查德团队还迎来了任天堂的一项重要里程碑：《塞尔达传说》系列诞生40周年。
为纪念这一时刻，任天堂计划推出经典作品《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的重制版，并举办以《塞尔达传说》为主题的现场音乐会系列活动。相关庆祝活动还将于明年4月迎来高潮——任天堂与索尼合作制作的《塞尔达传说》真人电影届时将正式上映。
《时之笛》重制版也是少数敢于在《GTA6》11月发售窗口期与其正面竞争的重量级作品之一。不过，面对如此重要的周年纪念活动，任天堂也需要谨慎平衡系列老玩家与新玩家的需求。

news.title: 《生化奇兵》电影会上映吗？导演权衡
news.summary: A movie adaptation of the popular game series BioShock has been in the works for a long time, and like a lot o

content.v: A movie adaptation of the popular game series BioShock has been in the works for a long time, and like a lot of film projects, it appears to be trapped in Development Hell. It remains to be seen how things will shake out with BioShock, but now its director has provided a positive-sounding update.
Francise Lawrence told GamesRadar that the team is "still working on a script," but he believes, "We're pretty close." He added: "I'm feeling really good about it."

Hollywood is littered with stories of filmmakers who are excited about projects, only to see them never materialize for countless reasons. That could happen for BioShock, too, but Lawrence is hopeful.
"Yeah, I would love to make it. I've been like dying to. I've been working at it. I've been trying," he said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/bioshock_7af817.jpg?w=636

A BioShock movie has been in development for more than a decade now, with Pirates of the Caribbean director Gore Verbinski originally tapped to direct for a theatrical release. He pushed for a big-budget, R-rated version, and the studio reportedly balked after Zach Snyder's expensive Watchmen adaptation flopped .

Netflix announced in 2022 that it had taken over the BioShock movie project, but things didn't go to plan. There was a regime change at Netflix, and producer Roy Lee said this resulted in the BioShock movie getting scaled back to become a more “personal” film .

The BioShock movie was supposed to happen years ago, but Lawrence had a full plate with 2025's The Long Walk and this December's The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping. With that movie finished up, Lee said he thinks Lawrence could begin work on BioShock in 2027 , though he acknowledged that anything can happen in Hollywood and plans may change.
Blade Runner 2049’s Michael Green and Terminator: Dark Fate’s Justin Rhodes are working on the script. There is no word yet on a cast.
Intriguingly, Lee said BioShock rights-owner Take-Two is “very anxious to see the movie come out” because the plan is for it to “coincide with some of the potential new incarnations of the game.”

Lee did not name any specific games outright, but Take-Two recently reiterated that the long-in-development BioShock 4 will see the light of day … some day. A remake of the original BioShock was reportedly in development, but was canceled in 2025.

As for the in-development BioShock 4, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick recently said the game is not dead and will come out “without question.” He offered this assurance to fans in the wake of BioShock 4 undergoing a partial overhaul to improve on key areas. Developer Cloud Chamber also suffered layoffs, with studio head Kelley Gilmore departing and former Diablo boss Rod Fergusson taking over. Some may recall how Ferguson was called in years ago to be a “closer” for BioShock Infinite to help get the game out the door.

news.title: 欧盟正在寻求游戏最具操纵性的货币化策略
news.summary: European consumer protection authorities have announced a series of "coordinated actions" aimed at 10 video co

content.v: European consumer protection authorities have announced a series of "coordinated actions" aimed at 10 video companies, accusing several of the biggest names in the industry--like Activision Blizzard and Ubisoft--of "dark patterns" that are designed to put minors and individuals at risk of gaming addiction.

If you've ever purchased in-game currency, then you're probably aware of how one of these tactics works. For example, Destiny 2's in-game currency, Silver, comes in bundles of 500, 1,000, and 1,500 units, but buying a fancy new skin for a set of armor ornaments costs between 600 and 1,500 Silver. That way, you're forced to purchase extra Silver that you don't need, and you can exchange any remaining Silver back for cash, creating what is essentially a one-way exchange rate conversion. Destiny 2 isn't an outlier in this space, as multiple big games like Fortnite and Call of Duty all have their own currencies, available through exploitative bundle deals. The key takeaway is that the setup of these bundles ensures that you'll always be short a few digital bucks on the one item you really want.

One of the few games that is changing its approach to in-game currency is Fortnite, as starting October 14, players can purchase the exact amount of V-Bucks they need. This change will also roll out to Rocket League and Fall Guys across Xbox, Nintendo, PC, Android, iPhone, and the Fortnite web Item Shop, but for now, it won't be supported on PlayStation.

The European-wide enforcement says that it's focused on practices that obscure real-world spending in video games, such as the use of premium in-game currencies, selling virtual currencies in set quantities that rarely align with item prices and thus force players to overspend, and insufficient parental control mechanisms. Under the coordination of the European Commission, the goal is to promote transparency and fairness, as well as protect the rights of consumers and minors when playing video games.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Minecraft-coins.jpg?w=636
So far, the following companies have been targeted by the Italian Competition Authority-led actions:

Activision Blizzard remains the primary point of focus, with games like Diablo Immortal and Call of Duty being singled out, expanding on previous investigations carried out on those titles. Manipulative user interface design tactics and poor customer support have also been cited as areas of concern. "These practices make it difficult for gamers, particularly vulnerable consumers, such as minors and individuals at risk of gaming addiction, to understand and keep track of how much money they are spending," the EC press statement reads .

Meanwhile, Sony has claimed that it doesn’t mislead customers into purchasing digital licenses for games (instead of actual ownership of the product) as it moves closer towards its all-digital future , and it is also set to pay out nearly $8 million to PlayStation customers as part of a settlement regarding digital game prices.

news.title: 等等党彻底输麻了！小米17Ultra全系涨价

content.v: 今年真的是等等党输麻了的一年，早买早享受还有折扣，晚买既没享受到，还涨价了……
就在今天，小米17 Ultra涨价的消息传来。
小米商城里，全系售价已经比原来高了1000元：标准版从6999元起变成7999元起，徕卡版从7999元起变成8999元起。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_6233492_4867810.jpg
标准版：
16GB+1TB卖9499元
徕卡版
16GB+1TB卖9999元
五个配置，整整齐齐，各加1000。
其中标准版入门款涨幅约14.3%。徕卡版顶配则只差1块钱，就能冲到真万元旗舰。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_6233492_4867809.jpg
更让等等党难受的是，旧机器涨价还真不是小米一家干的事。
先看华为，Mate80系列已经涨过一轮，同样是旧机器改价格。
12GB+256GB的Mate80，4699元变5499元，涨800元；同容量的Mate80 Pro，5999元变6999元，涨1000元；16GB+512GB的Mate80 Pro Max，7999元变8999元，也涨1000元。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_6233492_4867811.jpg
本来以为新机发布之后，上一代可以当个省钱选项。结果上一代先把价格抬起来了。
至于10月1日开售的Mate90系列，官网目前列出的起售价分别是5999元、6999元和9499元，对应标准版、Pro和Pro Max。
和Mate80系列各自的首发起价相比，分别高了1300元、1000元和1500元。
OPPO这边，最新的Find X10也把入门门槛推高了。
同样选12GB+256GB，Find X9首发4399元，Find X10是5499元，贵了1100元，约25%。
到了16GB+1TB，Find X9首发5799元，Find X10要7499元，差额拉到1700元。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_6233492_4867812.jpg
以前纠结要不要加钱上大容量，现在还得先适应一下“大容量比上一代多加多少钱”。
高一档则变成了Find X10 Pro Max，6799元起。对照Find X9 Pro的5299元起，入门价格高了1500元。
vivo这边也不例外，新旧两代的价格都往上走了。
先说X300。vivo去年发布时给出的官方价格，12GB+256GB是4399元，16GB+1TB是5799元；现在官网参数页的建议零售价，分别是4599元和6299元。
入门款贵200元，顶配贵500元，中间几个版本也有300元、400元的上调。
X300 Pro同样如此：不同存储版本分别多300元、400元和500元……
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_6233492_4867814.jpg
再看9月上市的X500系列，标准版5499元起，Pro版6499元起。
对照X300和X300 Pro的首发入门价，同为12GB+256GB，分别高了1100元和1200元，标准版的涨幅同样达到25%。
讲真，这波涨价也不能全怪厂商，硬件尤其是内存涨价都扛不住……
TrendForce在9月30日的报告里预计，2026年第四季度，传统DRAM合同价还会环比上涨10%—15%，NAND Flash合同价环比上涨15%—20%。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_6233492_4867813.jpg
这是在第三季度的基础上继续涨。上游合同价预测当然不能直接换算成手机零售价涨幅，但厂商接下来采购存储，预算仍然吃紧。
以前等等党最熟悉的剧情——手机越等越便宜，这个等待时间可能要大幅拉长了～

news.title: 网易全新FPS首曝！放话：要做下一代3A 剑指95分

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867820.jpg
“中国人能飞，我们不想给海外射击IP代工。”
文/秋秋&修理
10月9日，网易荒野事业部首曝了射击游戏《极限战场》。
6分钟的实机视频可以说给游戏的底都透完了：高拟真的枪械、细节的换弹动画和开火反馈、80人大战场的战术竞技玩法……一看就是款高规格的英雄+战术竞技新品。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867821.gif
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867823.gif
首曝前，葡萄君其实已经参与了两轮试玩。实际玩下来，我觉得这游戏是真有点东西的：画面品质上档次，光影真实到我脑抽在楼上对着自己的影子开了几枪……射击体验也比想象中好，像我这种不常玩PC射击端游的人，都没觉得有什么上手难度——能把高品质和好上手同时做到位的游戏，确实不多。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867826.gif
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867824.gif
不过体验完之后，我心里反而多了几个问号。
首先，英雄+战术竞技的赛道在国内可以说是公认难做，此前折戟的产品不少，也有人觉得这个品类已经不新鲜了。
荒野事业部自己都做过两款了：首个爆款《荒野行动》 （下称荒野） 是战术竞技手游，2017年上线，次年注册用户突破2.5亿，至今已经运营快10年，在日本市场颇受欢迎；第二款英雄+战术竞技手游《BloodStrike》 （下称BS） ，今年8月 刚官宣注册用户破2亿 ，如今在拉美、东南亚市场也相当流行。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867822.jpg
《荒野行动》近一年仍多次冲上日本畅销榜TOP 3
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867825.jpg
那问题来了，你《极限战场》为啥又选择了这条赛道？这真不会吃掉自家的用户吗？之前一直做手游的荒野事业部，又该怎么做好PC高品质体验？带着这些疑问，我们和荒野事业部负责人、《极限战场》制作人超神聊了聊。
把品质做到位
毕竟是荒野事业部首款高规格射击产品，想必大家最想先知道的，还是游戏品质如何。
先说画面。《极限战场》走的是写实风格，从不同天气下的高拟真天空表现，到地图上那些我以为能直接开走的载具，再到地面积水的光影变化，游戏在局内的画面表现不输主流高品质大作，实机视频里的一些场景一度让人以为是监控视角的实拍。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867827.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867828.jpg
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867829.gif
游戏在交互和演出上的细节也不少。比如检视和换弹动画各有差异，演出相当丝滑；子弹打在墙面、皮革、金属、玻璃上的音效和特效都不一样，连每块玻璃的碎裂形状都不同。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867830.gif
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4755670_4867831.gif
不过太真实也有代价，实际对局时，敌人往阴影里一站，我经常得多看两眼才能认出来，打起来爽是爽，描边也是真描边。
项目组其实也发现了这个沉浸感问题，因为一年前游戏还是卡通渲染画风，角色辨识度高，但代入感不够；现在游戏真实感上来了，他们确实需要一些设计帮助玩家识别对手，“比如给角色头上加LED点，或是在阴影下加专门的描边……但我们不会回到卡通渲染的弯路上。”
比如细看对手头上有红色标记，但当时紧张，又远，加上阴影，确实很难反应过来；
局外，游戏的角色建模也相当精细，角色拥有自己的入场动画和开局动画；
最让人惊艳的，是游戏藏品界面的枪械建模，我感觉比局内枪械更加高清，有硬朗的线条和丰富的光影变化，试用的皮肤预览也看着质感不错……现在看藏品确实有成为玩家长期体验目标的潜力。
画质被大幅压缩
综合来看，游戏在美术品质和堆料方面达到了PC射击游戏的主流水准，没有明显短板。而要做到这一步并不容易，因为从手游转向PC高品质，团队面对的是一套全新的命题。
首先是研发认知。荒野事业部过去的经验基本都在手游上，强项是性能优化和机型适配。超神自己也说，荒野、BS的画面对比同期竞品没有优势。
在《极限战场》的研发初期，他们以为只要放开模型面数、DP这些限制，“力大砖飞”就能把高品质做出来。但后来他们在上海和育碧、EA背景的专家交流，才发现3A的专业门槛、管线和组织完全是另一回事。比如手游的光照可能只管亮不亮，高品质产品还要一点点抠是否符合物理、光影有没有层次。
超神说，在育碧这样的团队里，真有人专门做了二十年树木、十几年岩石。于是从一年半前开始，他们在内部搭起了更细分的3A美术团队，一点点把这套管线建起来。
其次是引擎的选择。《极限战场》用的是网易自研的弥赛亚引擎，《燕云十六声》同款，所以这个引擎的品质表现已经有过验证。选择弥赛亚引擎的原因，是项目组认为当前情况下引擎能力大差不差，“大家基本都是80分，即便是UE5”，所以想要在技术层面把80分提到100分，拼的更多是协作深度和效率，看引擎能针对品类做多深度的定制。
弥赛亚引擎团队跟荒野事业部都孵化自网易天下事业部，他们的合作关系比想象中更密切。
比如早在研发荒野时，他们发现游戏小地图的缩圈逻辑如果用Python写，每一帧都在消耗性能，他们把问题提给引擎团队后，对方第二天就把这套功能写进引擎底层的C++里，性能问题瞬间被解决了。
但总的来说，这是弥赛亚第一次用在高规格射击产品上，也是团队第一次做PC高规格产品，需要面对的挑战还有不少。比如《极限战场》现在虽然在品质上取得了一些成绩，但团队认为在角色建模等方面，游戏还没有达到最理想的情况。这也是他们选择对外曝光和即将测试的原因。“验证我们的想法能不能跟上时代，或者有没有被时代淘汰。”
射击游戏，要先做好射击
除了品质，《极限战场》射击体验的打磨也达到了疯魔状态。
超神认为，FPS玩家尝鲜意愿强，什么游戏上线都可能进来开两枪，决定要不要玩的，就看这两枪。所以在他眼里，“手感是前面的1，画面、玩法、题材这些乱七八糟都是后面的0，要是1都没做好，再多0也没用”。团队给自己定的标准是让玩家开一千枪、两千枪，依然还想开枪。
从试玩来看，《极限战场》在“开两枪”上确实下了功夫。刚拿上枪的那一下，我就能感觉到枪的重量和晃动幅度都在预期里，枪线跟手，射击反馈清楚，几乎感觉不到延迟。教学射击时我都会抢答了，提前把教学人偶打倒了。
要知道我很少玩PC射击，英雄+战术竞技的门槛也确实不低。更离谱的是，线上试玩那天，我常用的鼠标不在手边，我只能翻出尘封已久的9.9包邮键盘送的鼠标，这玩意儿放在桌上都会偶尔抽搐一两下。但几个小时玩下来，它表现居然很不错，基本指哪打哪，真人组局也打进过最后两名。
怎么说呢，射击体验这东西说起来有点玄学，但还是能从《极限战场》的细节里找到一些答案。
比如子弹打在金属、玻璃、墙面上的音效和视觉反馈各不相同，后坐力和枪声很精细，子弹散布也相当真实。
我印象最深的，还是使用轰炸无人机的场景。首先无人机选中目标点后，镜头会有一个短暂的推近瞄准演出，光这个动效就给人一种“我瞄好了”的满足感；轰炸会同时在小地图和大场景上演出，画面相当炸裂。而真正让我觉得细节的地方，是我不用看、之前也没用过这个道具，光靠轰炸音效和画面震动的细微差别，就莫名其妙知道炸到人了。
这种符合直觉的设计，说明游戏对射击体验一直保持着高标准。
怎么做好手感这件事，项目组也不是从零开始。从荒野算起，他们在射击品类已经积累了十来年，荒野的第一把枪M4便是超神自己做的。而《极限战场》直接沿用了BS的手感标准来打磨。用超神的话来说，手感设计像是有五个串联的问题，从零开始会互相牵扯，很难并行解决。而他们在荒野和BS上已经解决了前三个问题，所以《极限战场》可以沉下心攻克剩下的两个。
具体来说，他们主要做了三件事：
一是以真实为基准。战斗策划会去打真枪，模拟真实的跑动和枪战，用来校准动画、音效和特效，枪械音效也都是实物录制。他们认为射击游戏的品质做到后面，拼的更多是物理和严谨性，细节越符合物理规则，最后的效果越符合玩家的直觉，玩家就能感觉“它就是好”。
同时游戏在枪械改装上的自由度很高，配件数量多、覆盖部位全，一些配件还能单独调长度、重量等参数，影响射程、移速、衰减、稳定性等表现，这能让玩家更细致地调节手感。
不会也没事，右侧还有AI帮忙配枪
二是PC端的升级。在BS手感的基础上，《极限战场》开放了移动端很难做到的实时光影、更多粒子特效和动画骨骼细节，让同一套手感在PC上更有质感。
三是综合调优。射击体验不只有枪的手感，TTK、机动性和关卡掩体密度也要放在一起调。“TTK长，加关卡掩体密度低，双方容易打不死；TTK短，掩体密度高，体验又容易变成定点射击”。
所以项目组会反复组织策划，进行4V4的遭遇战测试博弈空间，再据此调整游戏关卡。此外，他们还坚持每两个月做一次玩家测试……测到现在，他们表示目前玩家对整体射击体验的接受度都比较高。

news.title: 龙信2移除D加密可稳定60帧！DLC+大更新诚意拉满

content.v: 卡普空，一家很神奇的游戏公司。
你知道它肯定是能做出来好游戏，但每一款，他都能给你卡在80多分，这游戏大概率是好玩的，但总会有点东西会让你玩的不够爽。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867735.jpg
这种情况，放在2年前的《龙之信条2》也是一样，它有着一代成功的底蕴，拥有特色的随从玩法，物理交互丰富，开放世界的探索趣味十足，任务事件之间交织穿插，在RPG的代入感和沉浸感上也绝对是前列水平。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867732.jpg
但就算是这样，游戏首发的优化烂到玩家要去屠城，制作人刻意保留“过时”玩法限制，必须自己购买传送石、远程赶路只能用牛车还容易被野怪打断、只给了一个存档位；
过分追求真实感的下场，就是直到两个月之前《龙之信条2》依旧是一个需要玩家自己去对上脑电波的游戏。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867733.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867734.jpg
但众所周知的是，在10月9日《龙之信条2》就要发布第一个DLC“黑暗觉者”，而在此之前， 可能是为了保障DLC销量 ，游戏在9月初就已经开启了一场大刀阔斧的全面更新。
所以，在我们聊“黑暗觉者”之前，先来看下这次更新给《龙信2》带来了什么。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867731.jpg
这次国庆回老家的我自然不可能带上我的台式电脑，接受挑战的是我用当初游戏本拆下的CPU和另买的A卡拼起来的一台散装版台式，i5-8400和RX 5700的配置应该是低于大家平均水平的。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867730.jpg
但我只能说龙信2确实给了我惊喜，PC端在移除D加密之后的优化表现稳定，即使是我这台电脑也可以在游玩的时候保持60帧流畅运行，不管是在野外探索、多怪混战、还是主城闲逛，都没有出现严重的卡顿现象。
当然我的画面并不是最高画质，靠着调整新增的植被密度、体积雾分辨率等更加精细的、吃大头的设置后，这几天玩的相当舒服。如果在当初你因为优化问题没有玩下去，这次绝对不会让你失望。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867738.jpg
而在玩法体验上，游戏直接新增了3个独立存档槽，且每个存档都保留自动存档、中途存档、旅店存档功能，玩家可以自由选择存档、读档节点，再也不用担心自己忘记睡旅店导致一次读档几小时白费。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867737.jpg
在跑图折磨上官方也进行了全面减负，传送石价格直接减半，同时角色负重机制优化，更难进入超重状态，战斗外冲刺耐力消耗大幅降低。
当然，实际上在6月的一次更新中，游戏在序章新手期就已经直接给了玩家一块永久传送石，现在你完全可以无视那些一次性传送石，拿去送人、卖钱都随意，需要你365里路的地方也只剩下新地点的探索，现在完全不需要有任何赶路焦虑。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867736.jpg
你甚至还能在DLC中获得一本新的随从特技书：袭击对抗，只要带着这个特技就能保证牛车和营地不被怪物袭击，完全是对早期玩家差评做出的针对性优化，可以看的出来卡普空这次是真的怕了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867740.jpg
职业技能槽的数量也从4个恢复到了一代的6个，让每个职业都更加有构筑深度，我选择让自己的法师主随从把武器附魔全带上，直接享受RGB灯效，而自己的弓箭手就点出了不同箭种，应对各种情况。
不过我想能带各种职业技能的龙觉者应该才是这次更新的最大受益者，完全可以玩出更多花哨的操作。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867746.jpg
总之从今年开始，《龙信2》的所有更新都像一个人喊着“我不想死、快救我”就冲到你脸上，抱着你的大腿说自己还有救而且快治好了。
如果说以前的它还在追求着所谓“复古”，现在的《龙信2》才像是一个真正的“现代”游戏。
而这一切，自然都是对本次DLC“黑暗觉者”的铺垫。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_3341818_4867739.jpg
当你完成序章进入主城之后，你就可以在主线推进到酒馆会面贝伦特队长时直接开启DLC分支，通过对话获取新地图「诺根」的消息，并得知还有十二座遗迹等着你去探索。
所以就算你是一个全新的存档，也可以最快的体验到DLC的新内容，而你的老存档，只要不把剧情推进到黑化世界也能直接回主城开启。
当然虽然任务是很早就能接，但游戏还是推荐你40级再前往「诺根」，我13级就去看了一眼，只能告诉你死的很惨。所幸这次死亡直接带我前往「诺根」村庄，开启那边的基石后就能随时传送过去，不用被反复折磨。
所以在战力足够之前，还是老老实实在主地图升级为好，在DLC中更新的十二座遗迹，便是这段过渡时间最好的填充。
12座迷宫设计各有特色，有和斗兽场一样的清怪机制、有需要靠炸弹击杀敌人的攻略型迷宫，也有一边收集道具一边深入挑战的迷宫，在这些试炼最后都可以获得更加强大的武器装备，为进入「诺根」打基础。
同时在遗迹试炼中你还能够获得全新的道具“恩宠火种”，火种只能在诺根地图中散落的恩宠石塔处激活，从而获得增益效果、强化技能等。游戏也是用这一机制，将更新的两个玩法联系得更加紧密，不会让你在主世界的探索和新地区玩法产生割裂，算是非常巧妙的设计。
全新的极北冰雪区域「诺根」，不同于本体温和的探索环境，诺根地区以连绵雪山、冰封遗迹、废弃要塞为核心场景，越深入腹地，环境压迫感越强。
地图拥有专属的低温暴风雪生存机制，这里存在着刮起暴风雪的极端天气，在暴雪中会直接屏蔽小地图功能，并压缩你的视野，梦回《黑魂2》壁外雪原。
我只能说这种游戏体验不能算的上“好玩”，特别是在DLC剧情推进中还有一段时间会强制要求你在这种暴雪情况下探索一片不小的区域，并夹带着各处地牢需要你探索，除了折磨之外我暂时想不出其他词语来形容。
唯一仅存的良心，是你至少还能打开大地图确认自己的方位和哪些地方还没有探索，看到这句话的你应该会比我的游戏体验好一些。
（特别还是在夜晚的时候）
而在无防护的情况下踏入暴雪区域，角色会持续受到霜冻减益，移速降低、体力上限减少，严重时甚至会直接死亡。
针对这一点，游戏给出的解法是：热饮。
没错，《怪物猎人》的机制也被搬到了《龙信2》，只是在这里热饮叫做“温石”，靠在地图上收集矿物，就能调配出这一道具，消除冰冻debuff并保证一段时间内的自由行动。
而这次DLC主推的全新养成道具「战遗物」，同样是怪猎玩家最眼熟的一类玩法。
在诺根这片地区，你可以在野外采集、宝箱搜刮、魔物讨伐、迷宫探索里收集到未鉴定的「战遗物」。
把这些战遗物拿去给村子里的老奶奶进行鉴定，花费少量异界石就能获得一套拥有着新的“特殊性能”的武器装备，简单来说，就是给你的装备加上4个词条。
武器词条包括常规的“蜥蜴杀手、魔兽杀手”等针对某些怪物提高伤害，还有诸如提高击退力、攻击叠毒等能力提升效果。
不过目前看来最关键的还是技能机制革新，战遗物赋予的EX技能并非单纯数值加成，而是相较于普通版效果在特定方向上进行增强，有些甚至会改变技能的施展效果。
比如弓箭手提升扇形射击的箭支数量、增强旋涡射击伤害等，让本来冷门的技能也能有机会再登场，可能就是这次DLC最大的意义。
但也可想而知，想要刷出一套适合你现在技能组的装备，花费的时间绝对不可能少，在你看来这算是增加游戏可玩性，还是随机机制让你反复刷而不爽？这或许就要见仁见智了。
但至少怪猎玩家是很熟这一套了，所以为什么我会在标题说这是“怪猎2 DLC”呢？想必大家现在也知道了。
哦对了，预告中出现的饲狼，也和怪猎中的噗吱猪定位类似，你可以给它喂食、搞好关系，它就能带你寻找到地图上散落的战遗物遗骸，或是某个你遗漏的宝箱，想要让它有更多功能？坐骑？额外背包？或许得等下个DLC，或是玩家MOD了。
但不管怎么说，《龙之信条2：黑暗觉者》和这几个月持续的更新依旧是卡普空诚意拉满的一次行动。它没有堆砌无效内容，而是精准补齐了本体所有短板，让游戏真正达到了发售之初玩家期待的更好的形态。
如果你是弃坑的老玩家，凭借全新的技能体系、养成玩法和硬核战斗，足以支撑数十小时的全新游玩内容；如果你是观望已久的新玩家，本体完善优化+DLC全新内容的组合，是入坑的最佳时机。

news.title: 女仆店长多次被骚扰监视闹事！下定决心断绝父母关系

content.v: 原标题： 日本女仆店长多次被骚扰、监视、上门闹事，她下定决心要逃离原生家庭！
转载自微信公众号：叽哩酱
最近，日本妹子@べあもりゆるも在x上发帖表示自己要和父母断绝关系引发话题讨论，理由曾经在直播中多次提过，小时候就被坑过，长大后多次骚扰她，这次她下定决心要逃离原生家庭！
“早上好。这一次，我已经提交了分籍申请，和有毒的父母断绝关系了。感谢你们赐予我生命。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867863.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867860.jpg
这位妹子看着像是vtuber，但是是个露脸的主播，还是一家女仆咖啡厅的店长，直播中经常吐槽毒亲家庭成长经历，虽然生活过得苦，但是也成为了她的素材。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867862.jpg
曾经因为生活空间脏乱差引发过讨论，在今年7月下定决心整理，之前A老师发过关于她的一篇文章，我说怎么感觉这么熟悉！
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867861.jpg
上次没有提到过她的家庭问题，据她的直播中透露，父母小时候给她吃掺了洗涤剂的米饭，成年后强行安排相亲，她拒绝后母亲暴怒，多次上门闹事，甚至导致她无法正常直播、发烧休播。
偷走她约10万日元，一天发200条line骚扰，监视她的社交账号，还暴露过她的真实名字。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867864.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867865.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867868.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867867.jpg
这些经历让她长期处于精神压力中，曾因脏乱房间无法出门，工作压力暴瘦，现在终于下定决心分家。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867870.jpg
不过也有网友表示办理分籍也不是万能的，分籍不等于完全断绝，但至少能减少被找上门的可能。
“我本人也用过这个制度。 办理分籍之后，只要父母不去专门追查你的户籍，就不会被毒父母发现你结婚这件事，可以说是一个很实用的生活小技巧。
（如果是结婚之后从父母户籍迁出的话，父母那本户籍上面会写着「因婚姻关系予以除籍」；但如果先做分籍的话，上面只会记载「因分籍予以除籍」，之后你后续的婚姻等信息就不会再写进原先家里的户籍本上了）”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867866.jpg
“就算办理了分籍，依然还是可以查阅、调取你的户籍；并且凭借户籍誊本甚至还能拿到你的居住登记信息，所以一定要记得去申请户籍阅览限制哦。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867869.jpg

news.title: 游戏公司CEO离谱丑闻！4个夜场美女领空饷 贪了4亿

content.v: 原标题： 韩国游戏公司CEO离谱丑闻：4个夜场美女"挂职领工资 ”，被诉贪污4亿韩元
转载自微信公众号：GameLook
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867895.jpg
近年来，游戏行业内的“反腐大风”吹遍了大江南北。从国内几大头部大厂如米哈游、网易等公司内部通报的数起反腐案件来看，贪腐问题大多集中在美术外包、营销发行以及供应商管理等关键环节。随着反腐力度加深，不少昔日的光鲜高管最终都落得锒铛入狱的下场。
然而，就在大家以为国内大厂的反腐剧情已经足够精彩时，邻国韩国爆出的又一起贪腐案再次刷新了GameLook的认知。
犯事的不是普通中高层，而是老牌网游《天之炼狱 Dark Eden》开发商 Softon 的前CEO刘泰浩（音译）。他把在夜场认识的4名女性挂靠在公司名下领“空饷”，不仅发工资、配豪华法人车，甚至还给其中有的人挂上了“经营策划部部长”的头衔。
据韩国媒体透露，整起案件涉及金额高达4.5亿韩元（折合人民币约200多万元），目前该前CEO已正式被韩国检察机关起诉。
挂职“高管”却能带车参加公司团建
根据韩媒及检方公诉事实，刘泰浩将自己在娱乐场所结识的4名女性（姜某、宋某、变某、金某）以各种方式安排进其控制的Softon及关联公司One Tang Tang Games。
其中最为典型的是其内延女友姜某。姜某从2021年底起被挂靠在One Tang Tang Games名下，随后又在2023年3月摇身一变成为Softon“经营策划部部长”。虽然名义上是公司高管，但姜某从未到公司实际上过一天班，甚至在挂职期间依然在原本的夜场工作。即便如此，公司不仅向其发放了累计近1.86亿韩元的薪水，还为其租用了一辆奥迪A6豪华车供其私用，甚至为其支付法人卡消费。
更让人啼笑皆非的是，这位从不出勤的“姜部长”不仅大摇大摆地乘坐奥迪车参加公司的旅游团建，还与CEO在溪流中嬉戏，团建结束后，CEO甚至带领部分员工前往该女子实际工作的夜店进行“二次会”聚餐。
不仅如此，在韩国游戏界年度盛会G-Star期间，这位“挂职部长”更是作为官方代表团成员陪同出席，甚至在私下宴席上被CEO介绍给外部合作方为“未来的结婚对象”。
除了姜某之外，另外几位夜场佳丽也各有“待遇”。
宋某2021年被挂靠为“D1程序组次长（副部长）”，在完全不参与游戏开发的情况下挂领工资约1.48亿韩元。边某2022年挂靠为“经营策划部代理”，挂领工资约7700万韩元。 金某虽然未正式挂靠为员工，但公司为其免费提供了租赁的帕萨特GT轿车使用。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867894.jpg
对4名女性相关的贪腐指控
此外，刘泰浩甚至还协助其中有人骗取国家失业金和青年就业补贴，引发韩国劳动部门的调查与追讨。在检方认定的4.29亿韩元贪污款项中，有96%以上直接流向了这几位夜场女性。
随着事件爆发并进入司法程序，这位前CEO在法庭上的辩解更是令人哑然失笑。对于检方指控的4.5亿韩元侵占与背信罪名，其辩护律师竟声称“发给夜场女子的薪水，实际上是这些女性替CEO代领的个人薪资”。这一离奇逻辑当场引发法官质问，要求其提交能证明资金最终流回CEO手中的具体明细。
内部揭发被报复，投资方 娱美德 也被卷入
这样荒唐的行径自然引发了公司内部的剧烈震荡。
2024年下半年，随着CEO带内延女友参加研讨会和G-Star的消息在业界传开，Softon内部的高层终于坐不住了。洪姓副总裁在确认了“幽灵员工”及公款私用的事实后，要求CEO自省并提出解任要求，在沟通无果后向警方提交了刑事控告。
然而，面对内部的监督与揭发，CEO刘泰浩的选择是极其疯狂的报复与清洗。他不仅在公开场合对洪副总裁进行暴言辱骂，将其降职为普通员工、扣发薪水，甚至直接拔掉其电脑网线、删除门禁指纹，阻止其进入公司。
在召开解任副总裁的理事会过程中，CEO为了强行通过决议，甚至在会议召开前一个小时就在咖啡馆提前签好了会议记录。当现场负责签字的财务负责人（民某室长）拒绝在违规文书上签字时，该室长当天即被大不敬地给予“待命休息”处分，并在此后被正式解雇。
这场内斗甚至把外部投资人也卷了进来。早在三年前向Softon投资了25亿韩元的著名游戏厂商娱美德，在派驻会计师事务所进场实地调账后，查出了大量的假账、法人车私用以及周转资金异常问题。愤怒的娱美德直接向法院提起了要求返还投资款的民事诉讼，并对刘泰浩提出了诈骗罪的刑事控告。
随着舆论和法律压力的剧增，刘泰浩最终在2025年7月辞去了CEO职务。但他转头就与公司签订了月薪600万至800万韩的高薪顾问合同，继续占有法人车并在公司附近设立个人办公室，被指依然在幕后操纵公司。而最初站出来揭发丑闻的副总裁、监事以及拒绝签字的硬骨头员工，却无一例外全部被扫地出门。
后续的事情走向更加离谱。同时面对检方起诉与资方撕破脸的残局，Softon公司选择再次推动“无偿减资”，试图将公司资本金削减一半至10亿韩元以下。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_11132880_4867892.jpg
公司削减资本金的议程
根据韩国商法特例，资本金低于10亿韩元的公司可以合法地不设董事会、不设监事，甚至只保留1名董事。这意味着掌控公司超90%股权的刘泰浩，试图直接从法律层面抹去所有能监督和记录他资金动向的“公司监事与董事会”。
结语
比起中国游戏大厂动辄数百万贪腐案件、涉及复杂供应链与腐败链条的严肃反贪，韩国Softon这场由CEO一手打造的“美女挂职领空饷”丑闻发展到现在，其离谱程度更像是一场充满荒诞色彩的戏剧。
一个企业的经营秩序与内部控制，在最高管理者的独断专行下形同虚设；而那些试图站出来维护公司利益的员工，反而落得被解雇和起诉的惨淡下场。这损害的不仅是投资人和员工的利益，更是研发团队多年积累的产品声誉。目前该案件仍在法院审理之中，而那些被恶意解雇的员工们，也依然在为了应得的尊严与薪水抗争。

According to Ampere Analytics , tentpole Insomniac action game Marvel’s Wolverine sold about 2.16 million copies in September, making it the second best-selling PS5 game of the month, behind EA Sports FC 27 . (Obviously.)

It looks like a soft number on the surface, especially when you consider this is accounting for around two full weeks of sales. (The title is likely to be frontloaded, partly due to its nature and also because it doesn’t have particularly glowing word of mouth behind it.)

news.title: 渔网肉腿猫娘兔女郎 《GTA6》新图引露西亚造型畅想
news.summary: 《GTA6》新一批截图公开后，玩家分享各自希望露西亚在游戏中的穿搭，猫娘、兔女郎等造型陆续登场。

content.v: 由你来说： 看完新一批《GTA6》截图，你更希望露西亚以哪种风格登场？
2026年10月2日，Rockstar通过《LOVE》杂志公开了一批《GTA6》新截图，集中展现了两位主角露西亚与杰森的不同服装与发型，以及他们在餐厅、台球酒吧等场景中的相处画面，进一步凸显了两人关系在故事中的分量。作为该系列首位女性主角，露西亚的造型变化尤其受到玩家关注。
截图公布后，有玩家在社区分享了自己心目中露西亚的穿搭：有人把她做成粉色猫娘装扮，配文“我的露西亚会是什么样子”；也有人给露西亚换上黑色兔女郎造型，表示自己也会做类似的事。这些多为玩家自制的合成图或概念图。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092124595319.png
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092125087332.png
面对露西亚的各种造型，有玩家以杰森的女仆装作为回应，调侃“与此同时，我的杰森将会是这样的样子”，还引来了“伪娘与露西亚”的打趣。也有玩家提醒，想要在游戏里实现这类改模，得先等到PC版，并暗示这需要通过模组来完成。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092125217205.png
那么，你更期待露西亚在游戏里以哪种风格登场，又会不会给杰森也安排一套？

news.title: 新游尺度太大害惨网红！19万粉丝账号永封 收入全断
news.summary: 第一人称恐怖游戏《克里夫·巴克猛鬼追魂：复苏》发售后，一名YouTube博主因发布这款游戏的视频而遭到平台永久封禁。

content.v: 第一人称恐怖游戏《克里夫·巴克猛鬼追魂：复苏》发售后，一名YouTube博主因发布这款游戏的视频而遭到平台永久封禁。
法国内容创作者J0nathan表示，尽管自己已经用黑色方框遮挡了游戏开场的裸露画面，频道仍因违反YouTube的性内容与裸露政策而被删除。在他提出申诉后，YouTube依然维持了封禁决定，并回复称：“旨在带来性满足感的露骨内容不允许出现在YouTube上。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092116034661.png
《克里夫·巴克猛鬼追魂：复苏》由《战锤40K：星际战士2》的开发商Saber Interactive打造。游戏开场包含一段尺度较大的亲密场景，其中有一名上身裸露的女性以及一些BDSM情节。随后，男性角色还会在一段时间内处于裸露的状态。
尽管这段场景尺度较大，但它对理解游戏剧情至关重要，也是推动后续故事发展的关键起点。
遭封禁时，J0nathan的频道拥有19万名订阅者。他向IGN确认，这次封禁是永久性的。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092116094817.png
“我的频道被彻底删除了，10年的心血付诸东流，我最主要的收入来源也因此被切断。”他继续说道，“我以前从未遇到过平台方面的问题，没有警告，没有违规记录，什么都没有。可他们就这样把我抛弃了，仿佛我什么都不是。”

J0nathan表示，自己尝试通过YouTube的申诉流程挽回频道，但整个过程“似乎都由AI处理”。他的第一次申诉在几分钟内就被驳回，而他在社交媒体上联系平台客服账号后，得到的也只是千篇一律的回复：“我们已经审查了你的案件，并决定维持原判。”“其他视频明明还在平台上，而且展示的还是完全相同、甚至没有经过任何打码的场景，他们怎么还能维持这样的决定？”他质疑道，“这真的让人感觉，根本没有任何真人在审核这些案件。”
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610092116165817.png
“我真的彻底崩溃了。”他向IGN表示，“除了失去收入，我还失去了10年的心血和3000多部视频。这对我的情绪打击非常大。那些视频是我人生中很重要的一部分，失去它们带来的痛苦，实在难以用语言形容。”

news.title: “电子游戏”歌手迫不及待地想玩新电子游戏 GTA 6
news.summary: Rockstar Games recently announced GTA 6's in-game radio stations , and one of them is co-hosted by 11-time Gra

content.v: Rockstar Games recently announced GTA 6's in-game radio stations , and one of them is co-hosted by 11-time Grammy-nominated Lana Del Rey. The singer-songwriter had a connection to video games before this, as she recorded the song "Video Games" on her 2012 album Born to Die. Now, she's set to appear in the biggest video game ever, and she's pretty stoked about that.
Speaking to Rolling Stone , Del Rey said, "On so many different levels this is super special and a privilege. Can’t wait to get into the game and start playing.”
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/radio.jpeg?w=636

She plays the character Delta Dawne, and is a co-host for the Back Country radio station alongside singer Morgan Wallen as MW. Del Rey's husband, Jeremy Dufrene, will lend his voice to the game's Back Country Radio station, too, as the character Mud Dog Mike.
Elsewhere, the GTA 6 in-game radio stations feature other real-world famous musicians like Bad Bunny, and Kerry King and Tom Arya of Slayer

Music has always been a big part of the GTA franchise, and that continues with GTA 6. In the new game, players can listen to music in their cars and digest podcasts while walking around in Vice City through headphones. For more, check out all of the songs in GTA 6 so far.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, so its release is right around the corner. Fans have been waiting a long time , as the game has been in development since 2015.

news.title: 他一个人"淘汰"电视台综艺！期期百万播放 月入50万

content.v: https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867620.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867619.jpg
真人越来越没片拍，假人反而越来越赚钱。
当全球最牛网红Mr Beast为了拍一集视频，搭场景、请参赛者、筹巨额奖池。
另一边，在 AI 的世界里。
天天都是人类生存的末日危机。远古的冰原狼兽群入侵，1000 名人类要用自己的能力，在冰原上求生。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867618.jpg
土木老哥一抬手，从拔地而起一栋城池，徒手建立末世避难所。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867631.gif
挖机哥从天上召唤出了世界第一挖掘机，甩动长臂，一举干飞冰原狼。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867630.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867617.jpg
钓鱼佬也是不负众望，召唤出了一辆空军飞机。
https://imggifb.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867633.gif
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867621.jpg
在国内最火的美食节目里，来自全国各地的神厨，正在绞尽脑汁如何把一道九转大肠玩出花。
而 AI 美食节目里，来自印度的厨神，正在处理一大盆白垩纪远古沧龙的肥大肠。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867622.jpg
上面这些，就是当下短视频平台上，最火爆的综艺节目。
一集只有5、6 分钟，没有真人出镜的AI综艺，上线几个月就有 2 亿播放量。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867623.jpg
纯AI演出，0 真人成分，但大家就是看得不亦乐乎。
“ 一句 AI 否认了这 1000 人 7 天的努力 ”。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867624.jpg
“ 这不比真综艺好看？爽就完了。”
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867625.jpg
甚至连影视飓风，都在刷着这些 AI 综艺视频。
全是 AI 的综艺，到底能有啥意思？世超研究了一圈后，发现现在的 AI 综艺，已经进化得相当恐怖了。
五花八门，各式各样。 不论是真人 vlog、美食节目、竞技类节目，还是恋综、选秀， AI 都能做。
比如这个叫【 十万个挑战 】的竞技类微综，类似于平替版的野兽先生。
通过设置高额奖金，反人类或奇葩的挑战环节和多人 PK 竞技，刺激观众的神经。野兽先生悬赏 100 万，它就开出 10 亿美金。
几乎期期都是百万播放，几十万的点赞和转发。
要粉丝打投出道的选秀综艺，AI 也能复刻。
这个叫《 十二星练赛 》的节目，它把十二星座拟人化出道，用这些拟人形象去唱跳演出，选秀 PK 出道组。
仅仅只是播出半个月，全平台热度就过亿了，涨粉超过 40 万。
播放量还不是最牛的，更牛的是假的选手，真的饭圈。
里面每一个选手，都有自己的抖音个人账号。他们和真正的偶像一样，比拼主题曲的直排播放量排名。
有一大批真情实感的粉丝，在给 pick 的角色冲数据、控评、刷直拍播放量。
有人做数据站，有人建后援会，有人做美工图。观众还会给角色投票、做同人、站 CP。
“ 天秤座 nb 不解释 ”、“ A 组一定要超过 B 组，都来这刷 ”。
还有人一本正经统计每个 AI 选手的直拍点赞量、镜头时长，连镜头分配不公平都开始维权了。。。
这些做综艺的人，玩得也和真正的综艺节目一样。 画面相当逼真，很多你都分辨不出真假。
为了增加沉浸感，AI 偶像都和真人一样有上班路透。也就是偶像上班前，要跟在路边的粉丝互动打招呼。。。
明明全靠一句提示词生产的 AI，居然也和你拍什么幕后花絮、宿舍探班。。。
你也别急着笑。。。老外也爱看。
有人整了个水果人恋综，什么香蕉男、草莓女、辣椒姐配对谈恋爱，全网有 9200 万播放量。
现在都已经拍到第二季了，新的一季叫《 素食者岛屿 》。。
甚至湖南广电自己 AI 了汪涵和马可，整了个全 AI 版越策越开心。
硬生生给汪涵，都整成刘仪伟了。
可能看到这，你还觉得不屑一顾，觉得就是网友搞抽象，闹着玩的。
但如果我和你说，他们一个月能赚几十万呢？
就比如说《 十万个挑战 》，总共更了 28 个视频，21 期都有金主赞助，腾讯、豪士面包等等，都是他们稳定的客户。
根据星图显示，十万个挑战和 12 星练赛的定制内容分别在 14.8 万和 20 万上下。
一大堆综艺业内人，也都馋这块馋得不行。
“ 很多很久没联系的人，见到我第一面都在聊 AI 综艺。 ”一位参与过《 奇葩说 》和《 吐槽大会 》制作的资深导演梁阿怡和世超说。
在和她聊了聊后，世超发现 AI 综艺对综艺导演们来说真是致命诱惑。
很多人可能不知道一档综艺是怎么制作出来的。
梁阿怡给世超算了笔成本帐。选秀 101 这种类长线综艺，预算估计在几个亿。低成本的网络微综，一期成本也在大几十万以上。
而且，很多钱你省不了，光是请明星露个面，就要花去预算的大头。这还是在 2018 年国家强制每集艺人总片酬不得高于 80 万的情况下。
真人微综这边情况也不乐观，Tim 之前透露过，荒岛求生的直播，纯硬件成本就达到七位数。

news.title: 国货安踏买下PUMA！能跟阿迪耐克掰手腕

content.v: 1924 年，德国的制鞋小镇黑措根奥拉赫上，两兄弟成立了一家达斯勒兄弟鞋厂。24 年后，兄弟两分道扬镳，哥哥鲁道夫创建 RUDA，后改名为 PUMA （彪马），弟弟阿道夫推出了 Adidas（阿迪达斯）。
自此以后，提到这个制鞋小镇，就绕不开这两大世界级运动品牌。
晋江的经历，跟黑措根奥拉赫有些儿相似。
上个世纪九十年代，晋江还不是文学城，而是鞋服重地。靠制鞋晋江陈埭镇成为福建省首个亿元镇，鞋材生态的发达催生了安踏、特步、鸿星尔克、361° 等一众鞋企。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867708.jpg
任谁也想不到，这两个相隔万里的鞋镇的故事会发生交集：
2026 年，安踏成为彪马第一大股东。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867710.jpg
10 月 7 号晚，安踏集团宣布已完成以 15.055 亿欧元 （折合人民币约 123 亿） ，对价收购 PUMA （彪马） 29.06% 股权的交易，正式成为彪马第一大股东。
熟悉彪马的差友，心里可能嘀咕， PUMA 不是挺行的吗，怎么被安踏给收了。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867705.jpg
毕竟这只美洲狮，祖上真阔过。
很长一段时间里，PUMA 是世界第三大运动品牌，跟 Nike 跟 Adidas 一桌。
但最近几年，HOKA、On、始祖鸟、Lululemon这样的细分赛道强者不断做大，New Balance等老牌也重新崛起，传统综合运动品牌的市场被一块块切走。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867709.jpg
去年 PUMA 迎来了苦痛之年，营收 72.96 亿欧元，同比下降 13.1%，在叠加重组、减值等一次性影响后，净利润转盈为亏，怒亏 6.46 亿欧元。
更麻烦的是，即便剔除一次性项目，它的调整后经营利润依然为负，所以股价自然也是。。。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867707.jpg
2025 开始，PUMA 的战略目标就变成了： 重回世界前三。
彪马今年 Q1 财报电话会节选
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867706.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867712.jpg
另一边的安踏呢，也有些小困境。
最近几年安踏业绩不孬，但其主品牌进入了低速增长，第二支柱FILA业绩也趋向稳定。
如今安踏增速最快的板块是 “ 所有其他品牌 ”。
根据安踏 2026 年上半年业绩公告，该板块同比高速增长 44.2% 至 106.9 亿元，经营利润同比增长 43.9% 至 35.4 亿元，经营利润率达 33.1%，在三大板块中最高。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867711.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867713.jpg
你可能发现了，安踏通过并购已经找到了一套玩法。
过去综合运动品牌追求的是一个 Logo 吃尽可能多的场景，跑步穿Nike，打球穿Nike，时尚也穿Nike，一个主品牌尽量覆盖所有运动需求。
安踏也许是最不相信用一个 Logo 打天下之人，钟爱用钞能力买买买。
不断买入能跟自己互补的品牌，用品牌矩阵来打天下。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867715.jpg
这事现在都成一种梗了。
有网友调侃，自家附近的商场，二楼看着品牌很多，其实基本都可以叫安踏。
也有人吐槽安踏的 logo 太丑，放哪都不协调。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867714.jpg
网友说，LOGO 无所谓啊，想要哪个安踏买哪个。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_4630187_4867716.jpg
虽然安踏是真有钱，而 PUMA 的股价也是真处于低位，但这波绝对也不是图便宜。
安踏集团董事局主席丁世忠今天接受了第一财经的采访，其中有这么两段。
“ 我们看彪马已经 10 年了 ”。
“ 彪马具有很高的品牌价值，包括它的品牌资产、产品资产、运动资产，以及他们全球的价值链，这跟我们全球化布局形成优势互补。 安踏没有足球，彪马足球就很强；彪马还有很强的赛车装备，在跑步、专业田径的科技项目也都挺强的 ”。
啥意思呢？
全球的价值链，这个应该挺好理解，PUMA 在全球都是知名的，消费者认可度高，同时它有一套成熟的把产品卖往全球的链路。
至于品牌价值嘛。
运动品牌有个很特殊的地方， 宣传片拍得再漂亮，也不如一个顶级运动员穿着你的鞋站上领奖台， PUMA 这些国际品牌在这事上，有很强先发优势。
1966 年 PUMA KING 诞生，此后跟顶级球星高度绑定。
1970 年贝利穿 KING 拿世界杯冠军和赛事最佳球员，1986 年马拉多纳穿 KING 完成 “ 世纪进球 ”。
至今 PUMA 还赞助着大量国家队，从 2025/26 赛季开始成为英超官方比赛用球供应商。
PUMA 代表的就是美洲狮嘛，代表着速度、力量、耐力跟敏捷，这些年几乎跟速度相关的运动，PUMA 都还是挺活跃的。
田径这块，有个很经典的例子，博尔特。
博尔特 16 岁的时候就被签了，等到 2008 年北京奥运会跟 2009 年跑出世界纪录的时候，直接把世界上最快的人跟 PUMA 变相绑定了。
赛车这块，PUMA也早早做起了专业赛车鞋，2005年又开始与法拉利合作，这段关系一走就是20年。
但也得提一下，近几年顶流的球星很多都是被耐克阿迪给拿下了，尤其像博尔特这样跟 PUMA 品牌有极强绑定的顶流明星，更是相对匮乏。
不过，有过去的品牌积累在，PUMA 还是能在很大程度上，弥补安踏在这些赛道上的短板。
同时，在此前安踏收购狼爪的时候，咱们就聊过， 安踏特别懂挖掘中国人的需求。
安踏在 2009 年收购 FILA 在大中华区的商标使用权跟专营权，当时国内运动品牌的主流玩法是加盟商 + 街边专卖店，叙事依赖运动员 + 专业赛事。
安踏就抓住了 FILA 是国际品牌的点，找到了当时尚为空缺的高端时尚运动定位，不做街边店，往购物中心、高端商圈里卖，做时尚品牌的邻居。
品牌大使也是像舒淇这类偏向娱乐、时尚的明星。

news.title: 育碧又一游戏官宣将停服！享年不到8个月 公布都4年

content.v: https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_2649595_4867553.jpg
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_2649595_4867551.jpg
今天早些时候，育碧官方在多个渠道公告宣布，《彩虹六号手游》将于2027年1月15日正式停运。这款游戏在今年2月底正式全球上线，到如今“做出艰难的决定”，只经历了不到八个月。
在官方客服中心的问答公告中，育碧并未明确将停运归因为“游戏玩家的数量问题”，而是表示，这个决定是为了让“资源配置与公司的长期战略重点保持一致”。游戏服务器将在停运日期前继续开放，下一赛季也将按计划推出。至于是否能够退款及其他过渡安排，官方表示将在未来几周公布更多信息。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_2649595_4867552.jpg
回顾《彩虹六号手游》的运营历程，游戏于2022年首次公布，2023年进入软启动阶段，在持续数年开发测试中，游戏发布时间也几经推迟。最终在2025年于拉丁美洲地区上线，并在今年2月面向全球正式推出。
从公开数据来看，游戏在Android和iOS平台已经获得数百万次下载，Google Play商店页面则显示，其下载量已超过1000万次。
育碧目前没有公布游戏的活跃用户等数据，不过，在商店评价及社群讨论中，能看到一些非常具体的问题。有玩家提到干员解锁进度缓慢、付费机制影响体验，与PC和主机版的体验存在落差。在今年5月，reddit上还出现了讨论匹配质量、机器人对局等问题的帖子。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_2649595_4867555.jpg
停运公告中，《彩虹六号手游》的开发团队称，团队成员将转向其他长期战略项目。关于这次停运具体涉及多少员工、哪些项目会接收团队成员等更详细的资源调整计划，目前尚且还没有公开信息披露。
而今年早些时候，育碧确实出现了调整相关开发资源的动作。6月，育碧蒙特利尔工作室中超过100名参与《彩虹六号》及其手游项目的员工被调离相关项目。相关报道指出，这些员工当时预计不会受到裁员影响。
另外，育碧旗下其他手游的表现似乎也不尽如人意。例如，《全境封锁：曙光》（The Division Resurgence）未能取得理想成绩。近期，育碧还尝试将这款游戏移植到PC平台，但玩家反馈不佳。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_2649595_4867556.jpg
无论如何，《彩虹六号手游》作为一款经历多年开发的知名IP手游，不到八个月便宣布停运，难免令人意外。接下来，育碧是否会进一步解释停运决定以及“长期战略重点”，仍有待官方后续消息。
https://img1b.gamersky.com/users/clubcontent/2026/10/09/origin_2649595_4867554.jpg

news.title: Charlie Cox 为一款他还不能透露名字的世嘉游戏录制了 40 小时的对话
news.summary: Daredevil: Born Again actor Charlie Cox is starring in an upcoming video game, but it's not the first time he

content.v: Daredevil: Born Again actor Charlie Cox is starring in an upcoming video game, but it's not the first time he has lent his voice to one of these projects. At New York Comic-Con 2026, Cox revealed that he'd just finished recording his lines for a game that'll be published by Sega, but he didn't say which one. Hilariously, Cox mentioned that the game's crew was disappointed to find out he was English, not American.

"I did another one! It doesn’t have a name yet," Cox said to IGN . "I did a Sega one. I've done one since. It hasn't come out yet. It was fun to do. It's hard. It's a whole different job, man. I'm not sure what I'm allowed to say, but I showed up for it, and I met them for the first time, they asked me to do this game, and so I agreed to it. Then I had to do 40 hours or whatever it was, and I showed up for the first day, and I was like, 'Hi guys, nice to meet you! How are you?' And all of them went, ‘Oh, he’s English.’ They’d hoped, they'd wanted him to be American. But now I've got to do 40 hours of lines I've not prepared in an accent. Yeah, I think they thought I was American."
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Charlie-the-Hedgehog.jpg?w=636

The game won critical acclaim after it launched last year, and Cox was pleasantly surprised at how popular it was. While Cox was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards last year, he said he didn't deserve the full credit as the motion-capture for Gustav was performed by Maxence Cazorla. With Expedition 33 proving to be a critical darling, Cox said he was looking forward to playing it-- after he got a console for it .
His fellow Daredevil actor, Deborah Ann Woll , will also be popping up early next year in God of War Laufey on PS5.

news.title: PS5迎来AI画质黑科技 但大量老游戏可能无缘适配
news.summary: 索尼近期公布了面向普通版PS5的AI画面升级技术QSSR，旨在提升游戏画质。QSSR与PS5 Pro的PSSR技术属于同源下放、硬件互补的技术演进。

content.v: 索尼近期公布了面向普通版PS5的AI画面升级技术QSSR，旨在提升游戏画质。QSSR与PS5 Pro的PSSR技术属于同源下放、硬件互补的技术演进。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091913144000.png
不过，据Digital Foundry（数毛社）的专家分析，这项技术想要应用于已经发售的游戏，可能比预想中更加困难。
主要问题在于SDK，也就是游戏开发者用于制作游戏的软件开发工具包。Digital Foundry专家理查德·利德贝特（Richard Leadbetter）指出，目前尚不清楚QSSR是否兼容旧版本SDK。如果该技术必须依赖更新后的开发工具，那么开发团队就需要将已经发售的游戏适配到新版本工具环境中。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091913217789.png
相比之下，PS5 Pro此前采用的PSSR技术在这方面更加方便，即使游戏使用较旧版本的SDK开发，也可以加入相关支持。此外，PSSR还拥有一套通用库，能够实现集中式的画面升级技术切换。而从目前掌握的信息来看，QSSR似乎无法采用类似方案。
如果QSSR确实要求游戏更新SDK，那么最终能够获得支持的可能主要是大型项目。即便只是对已经发售的游戏进行相对简单的更新，也需要投入时间完成移植、测试和质量检查，有时甚至需要数周。对于销量已经下滑的老款单机游戏而言，这笔开发成本可能并不划算。
尽管存在这些潜在限制，QSSR对于基础版PS5而言仍是一项重要升级。该技术有望改善游戏画面表现，尤其是在现有的图像升级方案（包括AMD FSR）难以在1440p和4K分辨率下提供理想画质的情况下。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/09/small_202610091913283967.png
此外，随着新旧世代主机逐渐进入游戏跨世代发行阶段，QSSR也有望帮助普通版PS5在未来更长时间内维持不错的画面表现。

news.title: 《对马岛之魂》动画聘请《星球大战：幻象》人才于 2028 年上映
news.summary: The upcoming anime adaptation of Sony's Ghost of Tsushima just took another big step forward, with Crunchyroll

content.v: The upcoming anime adaptation of Sony's Ghost of Tsushima just took another big step forward, with Crunchyroll revealing more details on the cast and crew attached to the project, as well as a 2028 release window.

While details are still light on what the story will be, Hayate Inc . did confirm that actors Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu will voice characters. Saco had previously voiced Tomoe in Ghost of Tsushima, a master archer and pupil of the renowned Sensei Ishikawa, while Fukumatsu lent his vocal talents to One-Punch Man, playing the martial arts master Bomb.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GoT-Posters-1.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GoT-Posters-2.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GoT-Posters-3.jpg?w=636
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GoT-Posters-4.jpg?w=636

For the crew working behind the scenes on this production, there's some big talent attached. Takanobu Mizuno (Star Wars: Visions "The Duel") will direct the anime, and it'll be produced at animation studio Kamikaze Douga (Batman: Ninja, Star Wars: Visions shorts). For the story, that's being handled by Gen Urobuchi (Psycho-Pass) and Renji Oki (Azur Lane). Rounding out key roles, there's also Keiji Inai as the anime's music composer, Yoshikazu Iwanami handles sound direction, and Gyousyou Suzuki brings their talent for calligraphy to the project.
As for the source material video games, Ghost of Tsushima first hit the scene in 2020 for the PS4, and was later upgraded for PS5.
Its sequel, Ghost of Yotei , launched in 2025 and also received a " Complete Edition " upgrade that adds the Echoes of Sekigahara expansion and bundles in the Legends multiplayer mode.

Anime adaptations of video games are on the rise, as multiple other projects are in various stages of development currently. From Software's Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice and Bloodborne are getting the anime treatment, and the world of Hideo Kojima's Death Stranding is expanding with an anime film and a separate anime series that's on its way to Disney+.

news.title: 《我的世界：地下城 2》Fami 通试玩&访谈
news.summary: 《我的世界：地下城 2》已于 2026 年 9 月 29 日在任天堂 Switch 2、Switch、PS5、Xbox Series X|S 及 PC (Steam) 平台上发售。 作为以《我的世界》的背景设定为基础打造

content.v: 《我的世界：地下城 2》已于 2026 年 9 月 29 日在任天堂 Switch 2、Switch、PS5、Xbox Series X|S 及 PC (Steam) 平台上发售。
作为以《我的世界》的背景设定为基础打造的刷宝动作游戏《我的世界：地下城》的正统续作，本作在保留地牢探索乐趣的同时，还加入了在广阔世界中自由冒险的要素，并进一步强化了自定义系统，相较前作有了大幅升级。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/8f94871722a949f504f550bea075bf00/
本次，《Fami 通》编辑有幸在面向媒体举办的试玩活动上抢先体验了本作。下面将为大家带来笔者实际游玩过后对动作手感和系统进化方面的感想，同时还将带来揭晓幕后制作秘辛与设计理念的简短访谈。
无缝连接的广阔世界与更具深度的角色构筑
前作《我的世界：地下城》采用的是依次推进各个关卡的线性设计，而本作则在这方面进行了彻底革新，地图上的各个区域会无缝连接在一起，玩家可以自由享受探索的乐趣。虽然还谈不上是开放世界，但玩家已经能在推进主线剧情的同时，按照自己的意愿来扩大探险的范围。
《我的世界：地下城 2》的故事紧接在前作的结局之后。玩家们从邪恶势力的袭击中救出村民，并将他们转移到新地点之后，一场新的冒险又一次蓄势待发。在本作中，玩家可以直接与村民搭话交流，并且有了更多与村民的生活状态和人物性格相关的剧情元素。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/f0f24a5bea22adca5292d63a28619048/
角色的装备构筑空间得到了大幅拓展，防具不再是前作的单一栏位，而是细分成了头盔、胸甲、护腿和靴子这 4 个部位，允许玩家进行混搭组合。
不仅如此，本作还新增了装备后可激活被动效果的“护符”。再加上每件装备都会随机附带的特殊效果以及全新的“特殊”稀有品级，使得不断摸索强力构筑的刷宝乐趣和钻研价值有了显著提升。
顺带一提，多人联机游玩的便利性也得到了极强。除了本地与在线合作外，本作还搭载了寻找联机同伴的匹配功能。在此基础上，《我的世界：地下城 2》同样支持派对代码、好友列表邀请以及跨平台联机功能，随时随地都能与伙伴踏上轻松的冒险。
而开发团队倾注最多心血的，还得是时隔 15 年引入的全新维度“筛界”。这是一个自然风光极其壮美的幻想世界，有点像是另一个“主世界”。这里不仅有着细节满满的广阔开放式地图，还有每次进入都会随机生成的地牢，极具游玩深度。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/e010fb3058f0b2ad2d54f5eea6259082/
跳跃动作带来的立体探索体验
上手游玩本作时，首先给我留下深刻印象的，便是新增的跳跃动作。跳跃的加入使得跳跃攻击以及利用地形高低差打击对手变为了可能，极大地丰富了战斗时的策略。此外，当不知道该往什么地方走的时候，也可以按下相应的按键直接显示导航路线，如果想要快速推进主线剧情的话，该功能会派生大用场。
为了进一步炒热联机合作的氛围，开发者也在游戏内加入了许多细腻的巧思。比如新要素迷你物品栏”就可以在不打断游戏进程的前提下，随时调整角色当前的装备。并且掉落物品和装备是针对每一名玩家单独结算的，不会出现同伴间争抢装备的情况，每个人都会有所收获。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/85a00b7c1c0ef38c0b40b953519efad0/
另一方面，回复道具和炸药等消耗品的掉落和拾取则是共享的。在进行多人联机游玩时，同伴之间时不时就会出现“你血少你吃”、“那我就不客气了”之类的友好互动。
除此以外，游戏中还包含多名玩家同时救助倒地队友时可加快复活速度、能一边治疗自己一边救助队友、可一键传送到远处的队友身旁等功能。这些小设计能让玩家充分享受到在语音聊天中互相喊话、彼此互帮互助的联机合作乐趣。
在本次试玩过程中，笔者也有幸实际去到了备受瞩目的新维度“筛界”中进行体验。这里充斥着一股与主世界既然不同的奇幻氛围，色调也更加柔和。光是在这如梦似幻的风景中探索奔跑，就能够大大激发玩家的冒险欲望。
场景的显示效果会基于昼夜循环呈现出丰富的变化，同时地图上还会出现被灵魂力量侵蚀的强力敌人。打倒这些厉害的家伙后，似乎就能获得用于强化装备或者附魔的全新货币。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/fc4bec9f6b3219bb2396d8265910ccd7/
来到峡谷区域挑战“君主”的 Boss 战当中，大量初次登场的怪物如潮水般用来，战斗极具挑战性，能让人清楚地意识到“队友间的紧密配合是必不可少的”。虽然很遗憾未能将其打倒，但这次我所体验到的内容也不过是这个广阔世界的冰山一角而已。未来究竟还有什么样的冒险和战斗在等待着玩家们？真是太令人期待了。
深受《风之谷》影响的新维度“筛界”
在试玩结束之后，笔者也有幸采访到了两位核心的主创成员，他们分别是 Mojang Studios 的游戏导演 Mans Olson 先生（下文简称为 Mans）和产品经理 Nathan Rose 先生。在访谈中，我主要围绕开发续作的契机、新维度“筛界”的设计灵感、基于玩家反馈的改动等粉丝们比较关心的问题进行了提问。
—— 请讲讲你们决定开发续作《我的世界：地下城 2》的契机吧。
Mans： 在开发和运营初代《我的世界：地下城》的过程中，我们陆续积攒了大量想要追加的要素与可以进行调整的细节。与此同时，我们也收到了许多来自玩家的反馈和请求。在对这些内容进行整理之后，我们得出的结论是“与其在前作的基础上不断打补丁，不如从零开始打造一部完整的续作，让玩家可以更加自由地探索”，于是二代的开发工作就这样开始了。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/20e94695a761227add1d4ddaa8db7f52/
—— 比起前作，本作在地图结构的设计上似乎有了很大变化。
Mans： 前作更像是一个个线性任务按照先后顺序排列在一起，但本作中的各个区域却是相互连通的，玩家可以更加自由地展开冒险。虽然谈不上是完完全全的开放世界，但在这个更加开放广阔的世界中，探索的自由度与可能性无疑得到了大幅提升。
—— 新维度“筛界”也和主世界的地图一样是连接在一起的吗？还是说像前作那样，是一个个独立的地牢副本？
Mans： 算是两者兼备吧。筛界内包含能让玩家充分享受探索乐趣的广阔场景，并且你还可以通过时空裂缝等入口去到随机生成的地牢当中冒险，大概是这么一种机制。
主世界的设计亦是如此，既有手工打造的地图场景，也有每次进入都会随机生成内部结构的地牢。
https://p.qpic.cn/mwegame/0/0a48e1c9e3e4c7f77ad94e1014b4fe0c/
—— 能再具体讲讲筛界的世界观设定与灵感来源吗？
Mans： 最底层的灵感当然还是来自《我的世界》这个游戏本身。为了打造不同于主世界、下界以及末地等现有维度的体验，我们在色彩与视觉表现手法上狠下了一番功夫，努力避免与已有的世界风格产生重合，希望能带给玩家焕然一新的感觉。
此外，负责概念美术的开发者们也很大程度上受到了日本经典动画电影《风之谷》的影响，筛界那种充满魅力、美轮美奂却又带着一丝诡异的氛围正是借鉴了《风之谷》。除此以外，我们还从真菌、黏菌和史莱姆等有机生物中汲取了不少设计灵感。
—— 前作玩家反馈的那些细微的意见和建议是否也会大量体现在本作当中呢？
Mans： 没错。举个例子，前作中有很多玩家反馈说“不小心把小动物打死的话心里会很难受”。所以在本作当中，我们把大部分动物都设定成了“不会受伤害”的无敌状态。除了这一点之外，我们还采纳了大量来自社区的反馈，比如新增了跳跃动作以及引入无需打开菜单就能进行操作的迷你物品栏等。
原作者：けんけん翻译：奶油吐司车 编辑：熊猫命

news.title: 为什么草莓音乐节会做一场游戏展？
